name: Alex's Mobs
summary: 85+ New mobs with stylistic quality above the default game.
intro_zh: 加入 89 种生物，分为现实生物（灰熊、走鹃、虎鲸等）与虚构生物（末影蜈蚣、骨蛇等）。每种都有独特掉落、机制或功能，没有纯装饰生物；模型、动画与 AI 风格贴近原版。

name: Guard Villagers
summary: Village Pest Control
intro_zh: 为村庄加入守卫：六人一组生成，持铁剑或弩，主动迎击威胁村庄的生物（也可能包括你）。守卫会与村民交谈，声望足够时向你开放背包，可为其更换武器与盔甲；对傻子或失业村民持武器右键即可转职。

name: Naturalist
summary: Adds 47 animals *(and 66 variants)* to your world with immersive behaviors and drops.
intro_zh: 加入 24 种动物及其变体，目标是无缝融入原版。生物之间、生物与环境之间会有互动，部分可以驯服。
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Aquamirae
summary: Ship graveyard with terrible deep sea creatures!
intro_zh: 新增冰冻海洋群系：冰面上的冰迷宫与冰下的沉船墓场两层结构并存。围绕船长 Cornelia 的下落展开探索与进度，加入深海生物、首领、专属装备与氛围音效。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; food; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge; quilt; worldgen

name: Incendium Legacy
summary: A nether biome overhaul combined with challenging structures to conquer, unique weapons to obtain, and tricky mobs to defeat.
intro_zh: 彻底重制下界，加入 8 个各具个性的群系，如石英平原、枯萎森林、炼狱沙丘，每个群系有独立方块主题、3D 地形与结构。配套独特武器、可挑战的生物与首领，并提供技术向农场设计空间。
evidence: unique weapons to obtain, and tricky mobs to defeat
categories: adventure; datapack; fabric; forge; neoforge; quilt; worldgen

name: Mowzie's Mobs
summary: Mowzie's Mobs adds a variety of fictional creatures to Minecraft, priding itself in unique AI, rich atmosphere, and fluid animations. Prove your might against new bosses and enemies and claim their magical abilities as your own.
intro_zh: 加入多种原创生物与首领，以独特 AI、氛围营造和流畅动画为卖点。击败首领后可获得其魔法能力自用；代表生物包括伪装成蕨类、伏击路人的丛林植物怪 Foliaath 等。

name: Species
summary: A mod that adds fictional mobs to the game, with cool and unique functions
intro_zh: 加入原创虚构生物，每次更新围绕一个主题，由团队成员各设计一种动植物，并配套与其功能相关的物品和方块，目标是融入原版。
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; utility; worldgen

name: Legendary Monsters
summary: New early, middle, late game bosses
intro_zh: 加入覆盖游戏前、中、后期的首领怪，为生存流程提供阶段性的强敌与挑战。

name: Spawn
summary: An overworld wilderness overhaul that adds tons of animals, biomes, ambience and functionality
intro_zh: 重制主世界荒野：加入大量新群系、动物、氛围效果与机制。原生支持配置与数据包扩展，可自定义动物变体及生成位置；带指南书条目，并与农夫乐事、JEI 等模组联动。
categories: adventure; decoration; fabric; food; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Illager Invasion
summary: The illagers are back! Be ready to fight new foes. A port of Illager Expansion.
intro_zh: 加入近十种灾厄村民：炼金术士会投掷滞留药水，档案员为同伴附魔，猛击者持盾冲撞，掠夺者投掷斧头，术士召唤紫色火焰，死灵法师能复活亡灵等。部分藏在新结构，部分加入村庄袭击。
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Galosphere
summary: An expansion for caves, including new biomes, mobs, and more.
intro_zh: 扩展地下内容：水晶峡谷中生成两种新宝石与结晶结构，地衣洞穴长满地衣与巨型蘑菇并有小幽灵游荡，粉盐洞穴覆盖粉色盐层，另含配套机制与装备。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; fabric; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Bygone Nether
summary: Explore new structures unique to each Nether biome, as well as the new mobs that inhabit them.
intro_zh: 下界结构模组：为每个下界群系加入专属结构与栖居其中的新生物，同时重制下界要塞，并把堡垒遗迹扩展至玄武岩三角洲，补全下界背景设定。
evidence: the new mobs that inhabit them

name: Ice and Fire
summary: Dragons and Mythical creatures in minecraft.
intro_zh: 以龙为核心的模组：加入冰龙、火龙与夜行的雷龙，成年龙自然生成，可击杀或驯服骑乘。另有骏鹰、蛇发女妖、小精灵等神话生物，配套龙骨装备与龙血等材料。
categories: adventure; equipment; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Critters and Companions
summary: Adds a few new friends to your world!
intro_zh: 原版风格动物扩展：水獭在河流开蛤蜊找珍珠，雪貂可驯服帮忙猎兔并挖掘战利品，锦鲤群提供幸运，小飞象章鱼会给溺水者气泡头盔，海兔可采集黏液制作方块。

name: Ribbits
summary: Swamp villages and musical frogs!
intro_zh: 加入沼泽村庄与青蛙村民 ribbits：它们会聚在一起演奏音乐，商人、渔夫可交易植物方块与沙锤，巫师施法增益玩家，园丁负责浇灌作物，夜晚自动回家。
categories: adventure; decoration; economy; fabric; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Ecologics
summary: Simple vanilla biome updates, with fun mobs, blocks, and more!
intro_zh: 原版群系增强：海滩生长椰树，椰子掉落可能砸头，也可能钻出椰子蟹；椰子蟹壳能挡多次攻击，破壳后会逃跑，掉落可烹饪或当剪刀用的蟹钳。后续还扩展沙漠、雪原等群系。
categories: fabric; food; forge; neoforge; quilt; worldgen

name: EEEAB 's Mobs
summary: EEEAB's Mobs adds a variety of challenging monsters to your Minecraft world.
intro_zh: 加入多种挑战性怪物与首领，配有自定义首领血条。例如遗物歼灭者靠轮足与推进器高速机动，发射导弹与锯刃，只有攻击时露出的头部核心是弱点。

name: Adorable Hamster Pets
summary: 3,000+ Wild Variants, Procedural Genetics, Shoulder Launching, Diamond Sniffing, Cheek Inventories, Personalities, 50+ Animations, Wander Modes, and much more!
intro_zh: 加入仓鼠宠物：3000+ 野生变体，繁殖可产生约 220 万种组合；可穿橡果到下界合金的护甲，能待在你肩上、嗅探物品、把零食塞进颊囊，也能被当投掷物扔出去。
categories: adventure; decoration; fabric; food; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; quilt; storage; utility; worldgen

name: Mutant Monsters
summary: The mutants are back! Face scary creatures and powerful beasts like never before.
intro_zh: 加入变异僵尸、骷髅、苦力怕、末影人等强力首领，各自拥有专属技能与掉落，可制作强力武器与护甲；还能驯服爆炸小怪，并加入蜘蛛猪等奇怪生物。
categories: equipment; fabric; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge

name: Friends&Foes (Forge/NeoForge)
summary: Adds outvoted and forgotten mobs from the mob vote, expanding on their original concepts and adding new vanilla-like features. The mod includes: Copper Golem, Crab, Glare, Moobloom, Iceologer, Rascal, Tuff Golem, Wildfire, Illusioner, Zombie Horse
intro_zh: 把生物投票中落选的角色做进游戏并扩展其设定：螃蟹的蟹钳可炼制增加触及范围的药水，另有凝灰岩傀儡、怒目怪、哞花、冰术师等，配套原版风格物品与机制。
evidence: Copper Golem, Crab, Glare, Moobloom, Iceologer

name: Hybrid Aquatic
summary: Hybrid Aquatic is a mod that enhances your underwater Minecraft experience! Explore improved rivers, swamps, oceans, and undersea caves containing a variety of new creatures and blocks to liven up your world!
intro_zh: 强化水下体验：新增多种鱼类、鲨鱼、甲壳类、水獭、鹦鹉螺与一个小型首领，同时加入潜水装备、海绵、钓钩、板条箱、海葵与珊瑚等方块物品，并改造河流、沼泽与海底洞穴。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; food; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: The Man From The Fog
summary: A horror mod that adds a creature stalking you
intro_zh: 恐怖模组：夜里生成雾中人跟踪玩家，一段时间后转为追杀。生成频率、追逐时长、跳跃惊吓、跨维度、是否破坏方块等均可在配置中调整。

name: [Let's Do] WilderNature
summary: Wilder Nature introduces immersive wildlife, hunting systems, bounties, and trophies, bringing dynamic creatures and adventure-driven rewards into your world.
intro_zh: 加入可驯服与不可驯服的野生动物，并配套狩猎系统：猎获新肉类，通过赏金板接取任务换取奖励，生物行为与外观延续 Let's Do 系列风格。
categories: fabric; food; forge; mobs; neoforge; quilt

name: Bosses of Mass Destruction Forge
summary: WIP mod that adds boss fights to Minecraft
intro_zh: 面向终局的四个首领：寒地塔中的夜巫妖、末地岛屿结构中的黑曜石柱、下界结构中的熔炉、世界底部的虚空之花，均可通过线索定位，配有专属战利品。

name: The Bumblezone - NeoForge/Forge
summary: An unBEElievable dimension full of bees that becomes REALLY angry if you take their honey!
intro_zh: 蜜蜂维度：地形像蜂巢内部，有巨墙、水道、花粉区与巨型蜜晶峡谷，加入大量蜜蜂主题方块、结构与蜜蜂护甲；找到王座罗盘可前往蜂后所在，取走蜂蜜会激怒蜂群。

name: Rotten Creatures
summary: Rotten Creatures is a mod that aims to add a lot of awesome new zombie mobs to Minecraft!
intro_zh: 加入多种有个性的僵尸类生物。例如冻伤者在细雪中死亡有概率转化，攻击附带冰冻，走过水面会结冰，幼体死亡产生雪爆，掉落可烹饪的冻腐肉。

name: Tiny Skeletons
summary: Teeny, tiny skeletons, send shivers down your spine...
intro_zh: 加入幼年骷髅变体：普通骷髅、流浪者、沼泽骷髅、干旱骷髅乃至凋灵骷髅都有迷你版，自然生成概率 5%。它们会远程攻击，靠近后切换近战，各有独特弹药与掉落。

name: Illage and Spillage: Respillaged
summary: A continuation of the discontinued Illage and Spillage mod
intro_zh: 灾厄村民扩展（经原作者授权的续作）：工程师虽不善战斗，却会在村庄周围搭建炮塔等敌对机器；另有多种新灾厄村民与配套结构、掉落。

name: Nether Depths Upgrade
summary: Nether Depths Upgrade is a small mod that adds some extra flora and fauna to the lava seas of the nether. A total of nine fish have been added, a new enchant and potion in order to explore the lava in the nether.
intro_zh: 为下界熔岩海补充生态：加入 9 种鱼、一套新附魔和药水，让玩家能够探索并利用熔岩区域。
categories: adventure; decoration; fabric; food; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Mobs of Mythology
summary: Discover a World of Mythological Creatures in Minecraft!
intro_zh: 把各国神话传说中的生物加入游戏，作为探索途中需要应对的强力敌人，配套挑战与战利品。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Youkai's Homecoming
summary: Adds a variety of Japanese themed food and plants, and adds Touhou related contents
intro_zh: 农夫乐事附属：加入红豆、大豆、咖啡、茶、优昙花等作物与 100 多种日式料理，含麻薯、味噌汤、三色团子等可摆放的菜肴；咖啡提供咖啡因效果并抑制幻翼生成。
categories: adventure; food; forge; minigame; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Mythic Mounts
summary: Befriend legendary creatures to accompany you across the world!
intro_zh: 加入可驯服的传说生物坐骑，如 Żar-ptak 与 Colelytras，支持召唤法杖、跟随/坐下/漫游指令，以及只能载小体型玩家的迷你坐骑。
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; mobs; storage; transportation; worldgen

name: It Takes a Pillage
summary: The Pillager civilization has evolved.
intro_zh: 扩展灾厄村民文明：在世界各地生成营地与要塞，加入新的敌人、结构与战利品，提升生存流程的挑战。

name: Modular Golems
summary: Tinker style modularized metal golems
intro_zh: 可组装的金属傀儡：分金属、人形、犬形三类，各部位可用不同金属并附加升级。人形傀儡能使用武器、盔甲、盾牌、弓弩与三叉戟，但会消耗装备耐久。

name: The Knocker
summary: This mod adds an unpredictable human like stalker which follows every of your steps and may visit you while sleeping...
intro_zh: 与《雾中人》同一作者：加入单个多机制实体，会根据情境跟踪、惊吓或攻击玩家，并且“知道你家在哪”，夜里可能登门。

name: Duckling
summary: Liven your world with ducks!
intro_zh: 加入白鸭与绿头鸭，生成在河流群系；另有可交易的渔夫鸭 Quackling，出没于沼泽，附带节日水果蛋糕等物品。
categories: fabric; food; forge; mobs; neoforge; quilt

name: Realm RPG: Fallen Adventurers
summary: Improves world exploration by adding skeletons wtih treasures. Vanilla style.
intro_zh: 在世界各处加入 50 多种按群系与维度生成的骷髅冒险者，掉落矿物、材料、食物、装备与附魔书，部分藏有惊喜；地下还会生成稀有墓室，兼容多数群系与维度模组。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; food; forge; game-mechanics; magic; mobs; neoforge; utility; worldgen

name: Verity JE
summary: Verity, a small, intelligent, yellow sphere who can do many things for you, but don't get to mean, he will get revenge.
intro_zh: 加入 AI 助手 Verity：住在会动的盒子里，可对话与提供帮助；同时包含能生成 Verity 恶魔的恐怖内容，以及极致黑暗等改变玩法的效果。

name: Born in Chaos
summary: Adds a lot of aggressive mobs, with their unique properties that can diversify and complicate your survival. Also adds new structures, equipment, blocks and achievements.
intro_zh: 加入大量攻击性生物与一名首领，配套武器、盔甲、装饰方块和新结构。敌人需要针对性打法，兼容 Better Combat，可通过游戏规则关闭生物与结构。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; food; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Hamsters
summary: Introducing small, fluffy, and adorable hamsters to Minecraft!
intro_zh: 加入仓鼠与仓鼠跑轮，生成在平原、向日葵平原与草甸，可驯服饲养；后续版本计划加入笼子、食盆与可染色跑轮。

name: Dragon Mounts: Legacy
summary: The Dragon Egg has finally hatched! Let's ride!
intro_zh: 经典龙骑模组的现代续作：孵化龙蛋、养育并与龙建立羁绊，利用龙的天赋帮助生存；支持通过数据包自定义龙的品种、属性、行为、蛋与材质，适合主题整合包。
categories: adventure; forge; game-mechanics; magic; mobs; transportation; utility

name: The End of Herobrine
summary: Herobrine is slowly corrupting your world... defeat him before It's too late!
intro_zh: 以“符合设定”的方式加入 Herobrine：他从开局就存在于世界中，行为分为潜行观察、建造（用方块拼名字、布置陷阱与告示）等多种变体，还会赋予部分生物他的力量，攻击性随玩家行为逐步升级。

name: Fish of Thieves
summary: A mod adds all the fish from Sea of Thieves, fish fer ye pirate!
intro_zh: 把《盗贼之海》的鱼类以 Minecraft 风格加入游戏，并附带果树与新植物，持续补充更多内容。
categories: adventure; decoration; fabric; food; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Enlightend
summary: Expands upon the End in a unique way with intricate biomes, mobs,  & materials. AKA Enlightened End.
intro_zh: 末地增强：在末地岛屿间稀疏分布新群系，向上可进入类似小行星带的“上层末地”，向下可探索放射性 Enderneath 与稀有材料；加入独特生物、方块与物品，同时保留末地的荒凉感。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; food; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; worldgen

name: Doctor Who: Weeping Angels
summary: Don't Blink!
intro_zh: 加入《神秘博士》的哭泣天使：会把玩家随机传送到任意维度（含模组与数据包维度）。可用时间探测器预警，只能用镐造成伤害或用设备将其抹除，支持 Vivecraft 与完整配置。
categories: adventure; cursed; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: The Hordes
summary: Adds monster hordes invasions and zombie infection.
intro_zh: 可配置的夜间入侵：从午夜到清晨，怪物成波进攻你的基地，出现种类与时间均可调整。开启感染后，被僵尸击中的玩家与马会在 5 分钟后或死亡时转化，玩家会变成僵尸玩家。

name: Tide 2
summary: Expands the fishing system and adds 100+ new fish
intro_zh: 扩展钓鱼：新增多种钓竿（部分只能探索获得）、鱼饵槽与鱼饵效果叠加，每条鱼配有钓鱼小游戏，并加入 100 多种鱼与相关奖励。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; food; forge; game-mechanics; minigame; mobs; neoforge

name: Vampirism
summary: Become a powerful vampire or hunt them down.
intro_zh: 可被吸血鬼咬伤或注射吸血鬼血转化为吸血鬼，以血为食、惧光但夜间强大；也可以选择成为吸血鬼猎人，与吸血鬼及其他猎人阵营对抗。

name: The One Who Watches
summary: This mod adds in a terrifying entity into your world that will stalk you and try to kill you.
intro_zh: 心理恐怖模组：加入会跟踪、制造错觉并折磨玩家的“注视者”，它不一定要杀你，但随时可以；首日不会生成，只能靠听脚步、保持观察与拉开距离来规避。

name: Threateningly mobs
summary: Bring more obstacles to your survival.
intro_zh: 加入多个新生物与一条完整流程：分别在森林、雪地、沙漠地牢击败三名首领取得徽章，合成“三重眼”开启扭曲维度，进入圣宫后召唤虚伪圣者。

name: YDM's Fennec Fox
summary: This mod adds the Fennec fox to the game.
intro_zh: 加入耳廓狐：可用兔肉引诱并驯服，用兔脚、甜浆果与发光浆果繁殖，行为与原版狐狸一致，会猎杀鸡、兔与鱼，生成于沙漠。

name: What Are You Voting For? 2023
summary: Adds the mobs from the 2023 Minecraft Mob Vote (Crab, Armadillo and Penguin) to the game early!
intro_zh: 在投票开始前把 2023 生物投票的三位候选——螃蟹、犰狳与企鹅——尽量还原地做进游戏，让玩家先实际体验再决定投谁。

name: The Obsessed - Advanced Psychological Horror, Arachnid Stalker
summary: It stalks you with deranged fascination, each encounter driving its nightmarish obsession further…
intro_zh: 心理恐怖模组：加入一个对你产生扭曲“迷恋”的复杂实体，情绪会无预警翻转，拥有大量模块化机制与隐藏秘密，后续更新继续扩展。
categories: adventure; cursed; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Aquaculture 2
summary: Spices up fishing with a number of new biome-specific fish, recipes, and more!
intro_zh: 扩展钓鱼：30 多种新鱼可用任意钓竿钓到，也会在河流、湖泊与海洋中游动；新增可装配钩子与鱼饵的钓竿、钓线与浮标，以及收纳用的工具箱。不同群系（含模组群系）有专属鱼种，渔获可加工成鱼排。
categories: decoration; equipment; food; forge; mobs; neoforge

name: The Anomaly
summary: A strange anomaly in the files of minecraft has come to life, hide from it. (Horror) (Red's Anomaly on curseforge)
intro_zh: 恐怖模组：加入一个形似 Steve 的异常生物，它已经潜入你的世界，遇到只能逃；需要 GeckoLib。
categories: adventure; cursed; forge; magic; mobs; worldgen

name: Pet Cemetery
summary: Allows for the respawn of your fallen pets as undead versions!
intro_zh: 宠物死亡后掉落项圈，把项圈带到充能的复活锚即可将宠物以僵尸版本复活；僵尸宠物可用虚弱药水加金苹果治愈，再次死亡还能依次转为骷髅宠物。
evidence: respawn of your fallen pets as undead versions
categories: forge; game-mechanics; magic; mobs; neoforge; utility

name: The Graveyard (Forge)
summary: A mod that adds structures, mobs, bosses and blocks themed around the graveyard.
intro_zh: 墓地主题：主世界生成小坟、大型墓地、闹鬼宅邸与地下墓穴，夜晚出现亡灵与成群袭击，另有被烧毁的村庄、囚禁中的堕落勇士首领，以及记录设定的编年史。

name: Fungal Infection:Spore
summary: The purpose of this mod is to increase the difficulty of the vanilla game by adding new enemies and infection mechanics inspired by popular zombie type games.
intro_zh: 加入失控的真菌生物武器：感染者咬伤会传播菌丝感染，死者会作为感染傀儡复起，感染还会变异进化；玩家需要一边抵抗一边揭开它的来历。

name: Ben's Sharks
summary: A simplistic approach towards one of the ocean's most complex creatures.
intro_zh: 加入 26 种鲨鱼及多种有实际用途的物品，覆盖海洋生态；模组刻意弱化捕鲨玩法，鲨鱼鳍只作为邪恶灾厄村民的战利品出现。
categories: equipment; food; forge; mobs; neoforge; technology; utility

name: More Critters
summary: Adds new fantasy creatures in vanilla style
intro_zh: 加入 25 种有实际用途的奇幻小生物，产物可用于食物或制作武器；每次大更新围绕一个主题。另有流浪收藏家与可骑乘、可载物的 Carrybug。

name: Mutated Items
summary: 🧷 Turn 16 items into several dauntless creatures
intro_zh: 把物品丢进下界传送门，有 10% 概率变异成对应生物；例如火把会变成脆弱但执着照明的同伴 Torchy。
evidence: Turn 16 items into several dauntless creatures
categories: adventure; forge; game-mechanics; management; mobs; neoforge; utility

name: Whispering Spirits
summary: Adds atmospheric spirits for a horror-theme
intro_zh: 氛围恐怖：世界中会出现发光的眼睛，注视它们会消失并传来低语；幽灵本身无害。已停止开发。

name: Rainbow Reef
summary: Rainbow Reef is a mod that adds content to spruce up your in-game aquariums and coral reefs, including lots of new fish and sea creatures!
intro_zh: 加入多种现实中的礁石鱼类，并为每种可掉落的鱼添加食物，各有用途与定位。

name: Unusual Fish
summary: Adding fictional fish and other aquatic creatures!
intro_zh: 加入大量虚构鱼类与水生物，以及装备、方块和食物：鱼可烹饪或做成料理，附魔“Unusual Catch”后可用钓竿钓到，还有海脊方块、裂齿、天气贝壳与伏特探测器等。
categories: adventure; equipment; food; forge; mobs; neoforge

name: Dracolotl
summary: Ever wished that instead of hatching your dragon egg into a magnificent mount, you could hatch it into a draconic pet Axolotl? No? Well, here it is anyway.
intro_zh: 可把末影龙蛋孵成 Dracolotl：用三格高柱、环绕的黑曜石或基岩与末地水晶完成仪式，孵化后与你绑定并随你战斗；像美西螈一样水下呼吸，受伤时会装死让敌人失去兴趣。

name: Distant Friends
summary: Player like mobs that look at you from a distance
intro_zh: 加入远处静止、做出挥拳或潜行动作的类玩家生物，玩家一靠近就消失，营造被窥视的不安感。

name: Ultris: Boss Expansion
summary: Explore 8 new and exciting bosses to take on across your world, with new structures, items, and stories for you to unravel.
intro_zh: 加入 8 个带任务与奖励的首领，各有专属结构、物品、阶段、音乐与招式，难度覆盖前中期到终局。
categories: adventure; datapack; fabric; forge; magic; mobs; quilt; worldgen

name: Occultism
summary: A ritual magic system centered around summonable spirits allows you to automate various tasks, store vast amounts of items, let demons mine in void dimensions, create powerful enchanted tools and jewelry, get support from familiars, and much much more.
intro_zh: 仪式魔法：从“彼界”召唤灵体（恶魔）替你自动化任务、存储物品、在虚空维度挖矿、制作附魔工具与首饰，并可通过使魔获得支援；以《巴底买》系列小说为灵感。
categories: forge; game-mechanics; magic; mobs; neoforge; storage

name: Monster Expansion
summary: This adds monsters. Large ones
intro_zh: 借鉴《怪物猎人》的部位破坏战斗：怪物各部位有独立血量与伤害类型弱点，钝击适合破头、斩击适合断尾，可破坏或切断部位，强调策略而非无脑连点。

name: Hunter's Return
summary: Add evil Hunter's mob! They hunt the animals while making a cheeky laugh...
intro_zh: 加入猎人灾厄村民：住在森林木屋，会用弓箭攻击玩家与动物，把目标逼到角落后发出怪笑；残血时会进食回血，还会使用回旋镖与双持迷你弩。
categories: fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; quilt; worldgen

name: GoatMan
summary: Adds a GoatMan that can attack mobs and destroy crops into minecraft
intro_zh: 加入羊头人：平时游荡、吃作物、攻击生物并模仿附近的 mob 叫声；被发现后会根据距离与状态选择跟踪、追击、逃跑或瞬间消失。
categories: adventure; cursed; fabric; forge; game-mechanics; mobs

name: EarthMobs
summary: bring back to the Minecraft Earth Mobs with own twist on gameplay!
intro_zh: 把 Minecraft Earth 的生物带回 Java 版：泥猪、快乐的羊驼，以及会攀爬的 Boulderer、危险的 Viler Witch 等，分布在整个主世界。

name: The Pale Hound (DISCONTINUED)
summary: With arrows still lodged in its back, they serve as a reminder of its fearsome nature. Lurking in the icy landscape it calls "Home" where the cold has not slowed it down.
intro_zh: 冰原恐怖生物：藏在暴风雪与黑暗中，玩家进入其领地就会被追猎；已停止开发，作者计划重做。

name: Omni-Mobs
summary: Adds some random and powerful mobs into Minecraft for overpowered mob battles.
intro_zh: 加入多种强力甚至超模的生物用于“生物大乱斗”，自带音乐与镜头震动且可关闭；目前不支持服务器，仍处于 alpha。

name: Dark Waters
summary: There is something hidden in the storms and it approaches
intro_zh: 加入只在海洋风暴期间生成的新生物；听到雷声时，它已经靠近了。

name: Mo' Zombies Wave
summary: Adds 13 new zombies to the game, each with their own peculiarities
intro_zh: 移植 1.7.10 的 Mo'Zombies：加入 13 种僵尸，包括幸存者、Notch 僵尸、Herobrine 僵尸、矮人、厨师、下界僵尸、矿工、国王、骑士、海盗、赛博格、苦力怕与迪斯科僵尸。

name: Advent Of Ascension
summary: An all-in-one RPG mod with new skills, weapons, armour, mobs, bosses, dimensions, and more!
intro_zh: 大型冒险沙盒：扩展主世界与下界，并加入多个新维度；所有生物、维度、技能与装备都在重做，强调既能当主模组也能塞进现有整合包而不破坏平衡。

name: Cosy Critters & Creepy Crawlies
summary: Adds adorable atmospheric animals: birds, bugs, and bothersome creatures.
intro_zh: 客户端氛围生物：鸟群会成群飞行并落在高处，受惊时四散；小蜘蛛从蛛网中爬出；飞蛾被光源吸引；另有默认关闭的“瘦长男人”彩蛋，所有效果可逐项配置。

name: The Boiled One: Reimagined
summary: Horror mod that add "The Boiled One" created by Doctor Nowhere
intro_zh: 恐怖实体：不攻击时会缓慢逼近，玩家离开其视野 120 格便瞬移靠近；跟踪一段时间后选择攻击、惊吓后消失或直接消失。可配置在床边注视你睡觉并施加麻痹，或制造血雨。

name: The Anomaly Rephased
summary: Adds a creature that will stalk you and progressively become more aggressive. Not exactly a dweller.
intro_zh: 洞穴中的异常实体，会随时间进化变强，玩家越深入地下越容易遭遇。模组面向长流程设计，前几天不会出现，行为相对旧版有所调整。

name: Saint's Dragons
summary: Adds animated dragons that can do things
intro_zh: 加入可驯服、可骑乘的伙伴龙，属性与行为均可配置，面向想要强力幻想生物但不想走复杂进度系统的玩家。

name: Alshanex's Familiars
summary: An Iron's Spells & Spellbooks addon for 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 that introduces new creatures around the world called Familiars.
intro_zh: Iron's Spells 附属：加入散落世界的 Familiar 生物，可用 Arcane Essence 驯服，随你冒险并用强力法术作战；还能收进 Familiar Tome，放入 Familiar Bed 恢复生命。

name: Kobolds
summary: This mod adds tiny lizard people!~
intro_zh: 地下狗头人文明：可与它们交易，它们喜欢紫水晶碎片，会保卫巢穴免受敌对生物侵扰。另有和平的附魔师出售药水与“勘探者”附魔；森林地下生成狗头人巢穴，被僵尸杀死的狗头人会变成 Zombold，可像僵尸村民一样治愈。

name: DivineRPG
summary: 8 New Dimensions ♦ 115+ New Mobs/Bosses ♦ Hundreds of New Blocks and Items ♦ Unique Weapons and Armor
intro_zh: 多维度冒险模组：每个维度都有独特内容与首领，也有愿意交易的生物；加入大量新护甲、工具与武器，各自带有不同特性。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; food; forge; game-mechanics; magic; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Aether bedrock mobs
summary: This modification brings content from the addon of the same name for bedrock to the original aether
intro_zh: 把基岩版同名附属的内容搬进 Aether：新增水晶、迷宫、灵魂、盐、长者等地下城，以及水晶傀儡、Aether 娜迦、灵魂、盐蟹王等首领，并加入专属武器。
categories: adventure; equipment; forge; magic; mobs; worldgen

name: Wan's Ancient Beasts
summary: Are you ready to meet all the beasts of Minecraft's ancient past? Like the Sniffer, they are all creatures from prehistory and each one brings with it amazing new features!
intro_zh: 加入史前生物（BETA）：例如 Charger 可用蛋复活，平时会坐下休息，见到灾厄村民就攻击，只在被攻击或玩家手持甜菜根时攻击玩家；喂甜菜根后会进入狂暴状态。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; food; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; storage; transportation; utility; worldgen

name: CANTBREATHE
summary: The Incarnation of Fear
intro_zh: 恐惧的化身：极少且不可预测地生成，对视线敏感。被瞥见时会快速逃跑、指着你凝视，或全速冲来；1.20.1 版本不会破坏方块。

name: LivingThings
summary: adds various new mobs to Minecraft
intro_zh: 加入大象、长颈鹿、狮子、鲨鱼、企鹅、鸵鸟、火烈鸟、螃蟹、蝠鲼、浣熊、猫头鹰、考拉、蜗牛、猴子、海马、孔雀与下界骑士等生物，让世界更有生气；可用 Patchouli 查看图鉴。

name: Book Wyrms
summary: Colorful lizards that can recycle your enchanting books.
intro_zh: 森林中的彩色书龙：可养殖取肉与鳞片，用普通书繁殖。喂食不要的附魔书可回收成随机附魔书，7 种颜色对应不同附魔池：灰为任意，红近战，橙远程，绿工具，蓝护甲，青钓竿与三叉戟，紫部分模组物品。

name: Environmental
summary: Enhances the Overworld with new foliage and wildlife and introduces some simple biomes!
intro_zh: 主世界地表扩展：加入花木林、松树荒原、沼泽等新群系，并补充 Slabfish、鹿、斑马、貘等生物，强化原有群系的探索价值。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; food; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Fossils and Archeology: Revival
summary: The mod offers a variety of dinosaurs that are brought back to life through discovering bones, extracting DNA, creating Embryos, and making eggs. Along with dinosaurs there are other prehistoric creatures such as mammoths, smilodons, and DODOS!!
intro_zh: 通过发现化石、提取 DNA、制作胚胎与蛋来复活史前生物，共 60 多种，包括各类恐龙、猛犸、剑齿虎、恐鸟与渡渡鸟等；同时提供考古玩法与新装饰方块。
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; magic; mobs; technology; worldgen

name: Knight Quest
summary: Introducing an epic armor quest mod! Adds +30 armor sets, new mobs, and much more!
intro_zh: 30 多套带被动能力的盔甲、具独特技能的敌对生物、新武器、可驯服生物与三阶段首领。核心是圣杯，用击杀怪物获得的小精华合成大精华填充；兼容 Better Combat 与 Epic Fight。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; forge; minigame; mobs; neoforge; social; utility

name: Apocalypse Now
summary: Apocalypse Now is a mod totally focused on an apocalyptic world that was taken over by creatures that only live to attack and eat anything alive in the world, Explore the world to find a insane amount of melee weapons and new custom armor!
intro_zh: 末世题材：加入多种近战武器、装饰方块、废墟结构、可定制的僵尸与人类敌人、护甲和食物；引入流血、撕咬、疼痛、断腿与尸变等机制，全部可在配置中关闭。
evidence: creatures that only live to attack
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; forge; game-mechanics; mobs

name: Cave Dweller Evolved
summary: Fork of the Cave Dweller mod with additional changes
intro_zh: Cave Dweller 的增强分支：增加大量可配置行为，修复多人模式等问题，并提供调整生成与噪音计时的命令。

name: Jagm's Kiwis
summary: Adds cute kiwi birds!
intro_zh: 森林中的几维鸟：会刨地寻找种子、浆果甚至铁金粒，可用种子繁殖并像鸡一样下蛋；被击杀掉落猕猴桃，可食用或做成帕夫洛娃蛋糕，另有小概率生成激光几维鸟。
categories: fabric; food; forge; mobs; neoforge; quilt; worldgen

name: Golem Overhaul
summary: Golem Overhaul adds 9 new golem types, all with their own unique mechanics!
intro_zh: 加入 9 种机制各异的傀儡，覆盖不同材料与战斗定位，具体属性可在图库查看。
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge; transportation; utility; worldgen

name: Kimetsu no Yaiba (Demon Slayer)
summary: Japanese anime "Demon Slayer (Kimetsu no Yaiba)" mod
intro_zh: 《鬼灭之刃》主题：加入装饰方块、武器、角色、群系、护甲与食物。鬼阵营通过饮血升级，3 滴血升一级，50 滴满级，继续饮血还能增加生命上限。

name: Witcher (RPG Series Plus)
summary: Slay monsters like a Witcher! Spell Engine Add-On
intro_zh: 猎魔人职业：新增法印与剑术技能，装备法术书后施法；可在村庄凉亭或自建法术绑定台解锁法术，配套猎魔人装备与战斗机制。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; forge; game-mechanics; magic; neoforge

name: From The Caves
summary: Adds a stalking entity.
intro_zh: 加入一个会变换形态、跟随玩家穿越洞穴、地表与下界的跟踪恶魔，会以不同方式影响方块与生物。模组带阶段系统，玩家必须释放、激怒或采取特定行动来推进剧情。
categories: adventure; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Myths & Legends
summary: A dark fantasy mod that introduces mythical creatures, structures, and relics, all inspired by global folklore.
intro_zh: 黑暗奇幻：加入小恶魔、附身盔甲、骑士/弓手/审判官、石像鬼、黑骑士、受诅灵魂、Alp、Lampad、Abaddon 等民俗生物，以及配套武器、护甲与祭坛。
categories: adventure; cursed; equipment; forge; mobs; neoforge

name: CorndumGuardianReborn
summary: This mod adds corundum guardian boss from Corundum meadows mod in 1.16.5 to 1.19+ with more improvements.
intro_zh: 移植 1.16.5 的刚玉守卫首领：会双臂挥击、定时跳跃扑击，落地产生需跳跃躲避的冲击波；所有属性与冲击波参数均可配置，目前只能通过召唤遇到。

name: Villager Recruits
summary: Recruit and command villagers, manage armies through custom GUIs, enjoy PvP with diplomacy and team compatibility, and fully configurable features.
intro_zh: 用绿宝石雇佣村民组成军队，通过界面指挥；支持 PvP、阵营战、领地宣战与防守、原版队伍、智能进食回血与举盾格挡，并可下达群体命令。
categories: adventure; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; social

name: Werewolves
summary: Rise as Werewolf. An addon for Vampirism
intro_zh: Vampirism 附属：被狼人咬伤后受到诅咒，可变形为野兽形态，夜晚强势；与 Epic Fight 同时安装时狼人形态不会显示。

name: Dark Doppelganger - Irons Spells And Spellbooks Addon
summary: Summon a boss that looks just like you
intro_zh: 高难度多阶段首领：会镜像玩家强度、召唤小怪，混合施法与近战；被击落到虚空会传送回来，带专属音乐与血条，支持多人共同战斗。

name: Piglin Proliferation
summary: Diversifies Piglins by giving unique features to their vanilla variants, and adds new Piglin types to fill specific gameplay niches.
intro_zh: 丰富猪灵体系：为原版变种补充特性并加入新猪灵类型；僵尸化猪灵会保留原猪灵类型的装备与外观，各类型都有对应僵尸变体，可自然生成或由转化产生。

name: The Dawn Era (DISCONTINUED)
summary: This modification will add many new prehistoric animals to your game.
intro_zh: 史前动物模组：加入 15 种独特生物、方块与大量物品，全部自然生成，可狩猎与驯服；已停止开发，需要 AstemirLib。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; food; forge; mobs; worldgen

name: Unusual Prehistory
summary: A mod that allows you to bring back prehistoric creatures from the past!
intro_zh: 通过化石复活史前动植物：石头化石产出中生代、深板岩化石产出古生代，用分析仪提取 DNA，再用培育器配合有机黏液制作蛋、胚胎或植物；可用化石与书合成史前百科。

name: Nyctophobia Dread
summary: A datapack that adds a new horrifying creature to minecrafts caves and dark spaces
intro_zh: 在黑暗中加入神秘怪物：光照等级 0 变为全黑，它在暗处跟踪玩家，停留太久就会攻击；遇到夜视或光线会消失，并刻意避免露出身体。
categories: adventure; datapack; fabric; forge; mobs; quilt

name: Book of Dragons
summary: Dragons and more from the Dreamworks Dragons universe!
intro_zh: 基于《驯龙高手》的龙：每条龙都有视觉、听觉与记忆，具备狩猎、休息、探索、玩耍、守卫领地等自发行为；独立基因决定颜色、花纹与强度，可用龙之手册记录见闻。

name: Evil Hunter
summary: A new monster has appeared in your world and interrupted the ritual... you need to banish it!
intro_zh: 剧情向恐怖模组：推进故事阶段会出现猎杀、首领与结局，共三条结局线、两场首领战；剧情模式可能破坏世界与物品栏，可关闭。

name: Scorched Guns 2
summary: A pack featuring a variety of guns, mobs, dungeons and more!
intro_zh: 枪械模组：40 多种枪，从火枪、霰弹枪、机枪到自动导弹发射器与射线枪；从黑火药逐步升级到铜、铁、黄铜与金刚石钢，蓝图藏于宝藏、堡垒、远古城市与末地城；支持瞄具、弹匣与下挂配件。
categories: adventure; equipment; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; technology; worldgen

name: Brazil Legends
summary: Explore the rich folklore and culture of Brazil
intro_zh: 巴西民俗：加入 Saci、Cuca、Mapinguari、无头骡、Capelobo 等传说生物，各有独特 AI、群系生成条件与战斗或交互机制，并配套武器与玩法系统。

name: Hadean Breathe
summary: Several powerful bosses from Nether have been added.
intro_zh: 下界剧情向：加入首领级生物 Hadean Enforcer 与武器 Ember，背景设定为下界领主麾下三将军的残余，目前仍在开发中。

name: The man from the shadow (horror)
summary: Fight the nightmares from the past.
intro_zh: 心理恐怖：玩家被过去的阴影实体纠缠，服用药片可暂时驱散但过量会加剧；屏幕角落的蒲公英显示理智值，理智崩溃后幻象越来越频繁，最终实体获得实体形态。

name: Chococraft
summary: This mod adds a mob called Chocobo to the game. This includes different coloured mob...
intro_zh: 加入陆行鸟：有多种颜色与成体、幼体形态，用基萨尔野菜驯服，可繁殖；后代为幼鸟 Chicobo，会继承或变异出新类型，反复繁殖可收集全部品种。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; food; forge; mobs; neoforge; transportation; worldgen

name: outln.frombelowland
summary: net.minecraftforge.fml.ModLoadingException: somethingisbelowlandbelowlandbelowland
intro_zh: 慢节奏恐怖：进入世界约 3 到 4 个游戏日后才开始出现事件，灵感来自 wonderland.jar；不建议与 Sodium 分支或 Optifine 同用，可用 /belowland 命令调整强度。

name: Zombies+
summary: Adds more vanilla-like zombies to your world.
intro_zh: 原版风格僵尸扩展：加入奔跑者、爬行者、蛮力、弩手、弓手、尖啸者、斧手、剑士、邪恶化、洞穴、虚弱、缓慢、跳跃等 13 种僵尸，可通过配置文件调整以适配真实生存整合包。

name: The Deep Void
summary: Deep under the bedrock, a world locked in the abyss. Lurking, stalking, creatures wait patiently for prey.
intro_zh: 恐怖维度：落入基岩层 0,0 的洞即可进入，含骨荒原、血肉平原等群系，多种敌对与被动生物、招式复杂的首领、强力装备，以及失落文明的背景设定。
categories: adventure; equipment; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Doctor Nowhere mod
summary: A horror mod that adds Doctor Nowhere's creatures. At the moment, there is The Locust and Follower. Adds random events that can happen at any time.
intro_zh: 让世界变得空无一人：所有生物（包括怪物）不再生成，永远笼罩着雾，只有玩家独行。偶尔出现灯光熄灭、怪声等诡异事件，洞穴有专属事件，并会出现两只让人怀疑“这里真的没有别人”的怪物。

name: Luminous: Nether
summary: Explore new nether biomes with dangerous foes! Build with new blocks, and decorate with new decorations!
intro_zh: 扩展下界：加入 2 个新群系、16 种新生物、3 只传说野兽与 3 只稀有野兽，以及大量方块与新机制。真菌平原中有敌对的猪灵“邪教徒”派系，持有该群系找到的旗帜可免受攻击，还有蘑菇木套装与多种结构。
categories: adventure; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Infinity Golem Boss Fight
summary: This mod adds NEW BOSS INFINITY GOLEM. You can't find it in survival.
intro_zh: 加入首领“无限傀儡”，生存模式无法自然遇到：会双手砸地、召唤落火球、跳跃召火球并发出超级咆哮；目前仍在 beta。

name: Alex's Mobs Continued
summary: Alex's Mobs - Updated and ported
intro_zh: Alex's Mobs 的非官方续更：保留约 116 种生物及其模型、材质、动画与行为，没有重做或重平衡。覆盖 1.20.1 到 26.3 的 Forge、NeoForge 与 Fabric，共 52 个构建。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge

name: Mob Catalog
summary: Adds new mobs!
intro_zh: 加入 5 种可单独开关的生物：水豚生成于丛林与沼泽，喂食特定物品可帮你加工木材、西瓜与红树根；螃蟹的蟹钳可延长放置与破坏距离，还能攀爬原木；另有企鹅等。

name: The Midnight
summary: A dark and dreary place of eternal night.
intro_zh: 永夜维度：唯一光源来自水晶与当地生物，可通过裂隙进入。1.19.4 起需要先击败主世界的神秘生物，夜晚地表才会随机出现裂隙。
categories: adventure; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Ender Zoology
summary: Vanilla themed monsters to add some difficulty to the game. A remake of Ender Zoo.
intro_zh: 原版风格的末地怪物扩展：加入末影迷你、堕落骑士、凋灵女巫等，雪林中有恐狼出没，猫头鹰可带玩家飞越危险；配套传送炸药、诅咒药水与“灵魂绑定”“驱避”等附魔。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge

name: Wetland Whimsy
summary: An overhaul of Minecraft's swamps, adding new flora and fauna, a whole new biome, and plenty of secrets to explore!
intro_zh: 重做沼泽：新增“沼泽湿地”子群系、半日花、绳草与独特蘑菇、鹤与寄生蜘蛛，加入柠檬石与落羽杉木套装，以及散布的湿地遗迹与迷宫式沼泽地牢。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; food; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Endless Biomes
summary: Endless Biomes is a mod that transforms the End, adding new structures, biomes and life to the dimension.
intro_zh: Vanilla+ 末地扩展：群系以孤岛形式稀疏分布，保留末地的荒凉感。例如半影森林有全游戏最高的树，木质坚硬需用斧采集，发光树叶掉落 Endurian，食用可短暂获得抗性。

name: The John Mod Reborn
summary: The John Mod Reborn is a horror mod inspired from the 2011 Minecraft Mod, The John Mod, and the 2012 remake, along with the 2020 remaster of the mod. The mod aims to recreate a modern look of the John, featuring new items, textures, and more!
intro_zh: 经典恐怖模组重制：保留原版氛围并重做 John 的外观、物品与生物。John 皮肤苍白，躯干和头部各有一张嘴，会同时撕碎受害者并吞噬其躯壳。

name: Luminous: Overworld
summary: Illuminate and expand your base Minecraft experience with overhauled biomes, new mobs, new decorative blocks, and tough beasts to hunt!
intro_zh: 主世界增强：先重做森林群系，加入会躲避玩家的鹿与幼鹿、四种松鼠、环境生物、群系专属敌对生物与可狩猎的传说巨兽，并配套装饰方块与木材套装。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Ghost
summary: Adds little ghosts to Minecraft :D
intro_zh: 加入多种有实际功能的幽灵：森林夜晚生成，可用发光浆果驯服。给火把会去黑暗处插火把，给不死图腾会替你触发，给附魔物品会剥离随机附魔并返还经验；另有负责种树的幼灵与用树苗换紫水晶的 Kodama。

name: Sculk Horde
summary: The Sculk Horde unleashes an ultimate end-game challenge that will push you to your limits. Once triggered, the ancient Sculk Horde awakens from its slumber, hungering for the assimilation of all life forms in your world. Are you prepared?
intro_zh: 终局挑战：触发后远古幽匿族群苏醒并不断进化，前期由 Gravemind 召唤幽匿生物进攻，后期会亲自制造混合怪物，目标是同化世界上所有生命。
categories: adventure; cursed; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; worldgen

name: Grimoire of Gaia
summary: Mobs, Monsters, Monster Girls
intro_zh: 以增加生物、提高难度为目标的怪物与魔物娘模组，并非新手向，更适合有经验、寻求挑战或在游戏后期使用的玩家。
categories: adventure; equipment; forge; mobs; modloader; neoforge

name: Pigzilla
summary: This mod adds pigzilla, the gigantic version of the pig.
intro_zh: 加入巨型猪 Pigzilla 与会进化的咬人猪：咬人猪吃掉若干生物后会变身；Pigzilla 会踏地产生冲击波与地震，用獠牙把生物抛上天再咬击，造成额外伤害。

name: The Ravenous
summary: A mysterious and scary mob that will leave you no escape!
intro_zh: 加入恐怖生物链：小型快速的 Screech 发现玩家后会尖叫，召唤出更巨大、更饥饿的 Ravenous，后者会持续追猎玩家。

name: MEDIEVAL CRAFT (weapons)
summary: Medieval Craft adds 3D weapons, armor, mobs and structures.
intro_zh: 中世纪武器与盔甲：加入 56 把 3D 武器，需要把铁锭烧红后用锤反复锻打、淬火再组装；兼容 Epic Fight。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge

name: YDM's Red Panda
summary: This mod adds red pandas to the game.
intro_zh: 加入小熊猫：生成于竹林，性格中立，可用甜浆果驯服、用竹子繁殖，喂竹子可回血，死亡有概率掉落竹子。

name: MEDIEVAL CRAFT
summary: Medieval Craft adds 3D weapons, armor, mobs and structures.
intro_zh: 中世纪扩展：加入 56 把 3D 武器、9 个结构与 7 种生物，需先安装武器篇；锻造流程为烧红铁锭、锤打、淬火与组装。
categories: adventure; decoration; fabric; forge; neoforge; worldgen

name: Jurassic Reborn
summary: Jurassic Reborn (JR) is a mod based on prehistoric creatures from different games, movies, and fandoms relating to the Jurassic Park / World Universe. JR has added 112 different creatures such as dinosaurs, marine reptiles, prehistoric fish, animals!
intro_zh: 《侏罗纪公园/世界》题材：加入 112 种恐龙、海洋爬行动物、史前鱼类、动物与混合体，每种都有独立 AI、动画、材质与模型。
categories: decoration; forge; mobs; neoforge; technology; transportation; worldgen

name: Crimson Steve's Mutant Mobs
summary: Yet another mutant monsters mod here! This mod adds mutants in my style.
intro_zh: 加入变异生物，通常生成在原版对应生物附近。例如特技骷髅放弃弓箭改用武术，会连招拳击、踢击与上勾拳，掉落骨头并有概率掉头颅。

name: The Outer End
summary: An expansion to the End dimension that adds new unique biomes, structures, and mobs to the End.
intro_zh: 末地扩展：加入蔚蓝森林（巨型花与光谱蝶）、水晶峭壁（会缓慢生长的水晶拱）、原生池（卤水与潜影贝祖先 Sinker）等群系。末地塔有多层，塔下是大型迷宫，顶层将加入首领。
evidence: new unique biomes, structures, and mobs

name: Animal Garden - Owl
summary: Adds owls into the game, that can dance and take a rest on your shoulder.
intro_zh: 加入猫头鹰：默认生成于森林，可用肉驯服，会对唱片机“开派对”，也能停在玩家肩上休息。

name: Primal
summary: Enhances on the wilderness aspect of the game
intro_zh: 强化荒野生存：加入狩猎与采集相关内容，让野外探索和生存更有沉浸感，具体内容见官方 wiki。

name: Spooky Music Trader
summary: Adds a new trader mansion, along with a collection of spooky tradable music discs
intro_zh: 加入仅在黑森林生成的“商人宅邸”，可用怪物战利品与宅邸商人交易恐怖风格唱片，并新增可收纳全部唱片的专辑物品。

name: Whisperwoods
summary: Adds spooky forest creatures like wisps, moths, hidebehinds, and the hirschgeist!
intro_zh: 恐怖森林主题：飞蛾会被光源吸引，甚至弄坏火把；Hidebehind 会无声跟踪猎物，被发现时躲到树后并“融进树里”，但发光的眼睛会暴露它，而且它怕光。
categories: adventure; decoration; fabric; forge; magic; mobs; worldgen

name: 000.jar
summary: you are in a Minecraft Arg with a new entity
intro_zh: 心理与环境恐怖：世界被损坏的实体入侵，它会设法把玩家赶出自己的游戏。没有固定的 jumpscare，事件随机且可配置，强调“有什么不对劲”的旧版本氛围。

name: Flower Mimics
summary: 👻 SpookyJam 2023: Be careful around flowers at night.. they might transform into monsters!
intro_zh: 夜间行走时花朵有 1/50 概率变成怪物并伴随闪电，怪物有专属名字，击杀掉落额外物品与经验，原花朵会放回原位；触发条件、可用花朵与掉落均可配置。
categories: adventure; cursed; fabric; forge; game-mechanics; magic; mobs; neoforge; quilt

name: From Another World
summary: Adds an extremely dangerous alien species (based on The Thing) to Minecraft!
intro_zh: 基于《怪形》的外星拟态生物：不会随机刷怪或消失，而是像真实生物一样有固定的繁殖与扩散方式；整体按原版生存平衡设计。
categories: cursed; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; quilt

name: Invasion Code Red Reborn(Illager Boss)
summary: This mod adds a raider boss called the gashslit
intro_zh: 加入灾厄首领 Gashslit：有概率在袭击中出现，680 点生命，血量越低防御与攻击越高；40% 血量进入二阶段并解锁新招式，能发射剑气、冲锋、召唤裂刃龙，还能短暂无敌格挡。

name: DragonMine Z - Dragon Ball in Minecraft!
summary: DragonBall Mod that let's you create your own Character, explore other worlds and fight strong enemies!
intro_zh: 龙珠题材：可创建人类、赛亚人、那美克星人、冰冻恶魔、生化人与魔人等角色并自定义外观，拥有力量、打击、抗性、体力、气与能量六项属性成长；加入天神殿、卡林塔、大长老之家等结构。
categories: adventure; cursed; equipment; forge; game-mechanics; magic; mobs; social; technology; utility; worldgen

name: Error 404 Not Found (Horror Entity)
summary: Adds a mysterious entity into your world.
intro_zh: 恐怖实体：世界出现贴图缺失、诡异生物与天空传送门，实体跟踪、攻击并“让游戏崩溃”（可关闭），会腐蚀附近方块贴图、熄灭你的火把；最终需要上天空寻找幕后计算机。

name: Earth2Java
summary: Minecraft Earth mobs ported to Minecraft Java Edition
intro_zh: 把 Minecraft Earth 的生物与物品移植到 Java 版，保留其独特行为，如哞花与热带史莱姆；1.20 起按标签生成，可适配模组群系。
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; quilt; worldgen

name: Snuffles
summary: Adds Snuffles, a new mob to snowy biomes!
intro_zh: 雪原生物：可用土豆繁殖，会吐着舌头跑来；毛发结霜后可用岩浆膏或火去除。可剪毛获得 Fluff 装饰方块，踩上去会飘雪花，用黏液球还能切换 4 种发型。

name: DontCry (Horror) (Stalker) (Terror) (Scary)(Twixxel)
summary: Adds unique stalkers and monsters inspired by creatures commonly seen in YouTube horror content. Experience new threats, suspenseful encounters, and original hostile mobs in your Minecraft world on Forge.
intro_zh: 恐怖模组：加入多种原创尾随者与怪物，风格参考 YouTube 恐怖视频中的生物，拥有独特外观、行为与遭遇方式。

name: Companions!
summary: A mod that adds 10 new tamable creatures called companions!
intro_zh: 加入 10 种可驯服伙伴，各有特殊能力，另有具独特技能的敌对生物、新武器与首领。伙伴可用击杀怪物获得的小/大精华治疗，支持漫游、坐下与跟随三种状态。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; forge; game-mechanics; magic; mobs; neoforge; utility

name: Playmate (horror)
summary: Adds a friend to play hide and seek with!
intro_zh: 恐怖捉迷藏：连续两晚不睡后第三晚开始游戏，随机扮演躲藏或寻找。躲藏需在暗处安静坚持 60 秒，寻找需在倒计时内找到 Playmate 三次，它还可能烧掉你的床。

name: Bad Dreams
summary: Adds [Configurable] Nightmares When Sleeping in The Dark.
intro_zh: 让睡眠不再安全：光照 ≤5 时有 25% 概率做噩梦，≥8 时有概率做好梦。噩梦分视觉幻觉与生成敌对生物的“危险噩梦”，好梦会带小奖励，概率与阈值均可配置。
evidence: Nightmares When Sleeping in The Dark

name: Mutants and Zombies
summary: This mod adds new Mutant and Zombie mobs.
intro_zh: Ryan's Zombies 的官方重制：加入僵尸蛮力、爬行者、喷吐者、水疱僵尸、裂头僵尸、变异蛮力、腐烂变异体等，模型由 Nice_Try_Boi 制作。
categories: adventure; cursed; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge

name: THE UNDEAD REVAMPED
summary: This mod add some new types of undeads.
intro_zh: 加入 29 种新亡灵（多为僵尸），强度高且各有弱点，模组整体让生存更有挑战；许多敌人可以选择逃跑而不是硬拼。

name: Super Powers
summary: SVM Powers is a Super Power datapack adding a variety of abilities, new structures, mobs, items and more!
intro_zh: 数据包：加入 16 种超能力，包括相位、闪电、植物、史莱姆、爆炸、冰、重力、维度旅行、鹰身女妖、火、虚空、时间、治疗、死亡、复制与水，并配套首领、NPC、结构与强力物品。
categories: adventure; datapack; equipment; fabric; food; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge; quilt; worldgen

name: Faunify
summary: Adds adorable wild animals and pets to your world!
intro_zh: 加入 6 种可驯服的可爱生物与 15 种以上氛围小动物：黄鼠狼在雪原会换白毛，可驯服，附近丢蛋会挖沙砾、沙子或泥土找资源；繁殖两只驯服黄鼠狼有概率得到雪貂；龙猫可沙浴产出粉末，扔向怪物能减速致盲。

name: Mobvote 2023 - Crab
summary: This mod contains the 2023 mobvote crab mob
intro_zh: 加入 2023 生物投票的螃蟹：受击有 25% 概率掉蟹钳，5 到 10 分钟再生。蟹钳可延长约 4 格放置与攻击距离并消耗耐久，也能烹饪；螃蟹会爬方块，生成在红树林沼泽，可用海草引诱繁殖。

name: Caerula Arbor
summary: Adapted from Mitsuki and Caerula Arbor from Arknights, which adds varieties of water mobs invading the Land.
intro_zh: 源自《明日方舟》的海嗣：会入侵陆地、吞食生物并占领主世界。它们会持续进化，越往后血量、攻击、技能与数量越强；击杀可收集组织制作装备，也可食用，但处理不当会有代价。

name: The Root of Fear
summary: Adds a unique tree-like horror mob called the Wilted. Be prepared, because this terrifying experience is very different to the average dweller mod. The Wilted is a mutant relative of the Creaking that has escaped the Pale Garden.
intro_zh: 加入“枯萎者”：与 Creaking 同源但已脱离苍白花园，以黑暗为力量，专门盯上作为光源的玩家，AI 每次生成都会随机化行为。袭击前两晚会有声音预警，当天大雾，夜晚伪装现身；需要在照明区域打断覆盖灯光的根系并坚持到结束。

name: [TACZ] NPCs
summary: Fully animated neutral and enemy NPCs with loot tables and proper player-like TACZ shooting.
intro_zh: TaCZ 附属：NPC 会像玩家一样使用任意 TaCZ 枪械，包括火箭筒、榴弹发射器与喷火器；支持 PlayerAnimator 动作与玩家皮肤，可通过配置创建不同阵营、关系与装备的 NPC，并让阵营实时交战。

name: True Herobrine
summary: Adds Herobrine, but in a non-destructive way.
intro_zh: 忠于传说的 Herobrine：不毁世界也不追杀，只是偶尔生成并静静注视你两分钟；靠近 25 格内会消失，更偏好在 y60 以上生成，所有参数可配置。

name: Animal Garden - Sea Otter
summary: Adds the tamable sea otters into the game, that will fight and protect you when in need.
intro_zh: 加入可驯服的海獭：可用任意鱼类驯服与繁殖，有漫游、坐下、跟随三种行为；陆地移动慢，更适合水中使用，受伤时会保护同伴，附近有鱼会去吃来恢复生命。

name: Twixxel's Stalker (port)
summary: Adds The Stalker, a Silent Hunter that pursues you when you're not looking.
intro_zh: 加入潜行者：被直视时无法移动，视线一移开就会高速逼近；会在森林、洞穴与废弃结构中远距离跟踪玩家。

name: Face of Horror
summary: You never know who's watching you from the shadows...
intro_zh: 恐怖模组：不持续刷怪，而是在暗角出现面孔、耳边低语、突然的声响，满月夜更危险。核心是动态 jumpscare 系统，会在角落、墙后与阴影中寻找位置，触发时短暂麻痹、锁定镜头并播放恐怖音效。
categories: cursed; fabric; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge

name: Animal Garden - Porcupine
summary: Adds porcupines into the game.
intro_zh: 加入可驯服的豪猪：生成于森林，攻击者靠近会被刺伤；可用苹果驯服、甜浆果繁殖并少量回血，默认护甲值较高。

name: Nocturnal Dweller
summary: You will be haunted by the Nocturnal Dweller, a long critter that will appear in your world once every certain amount of time.
intro_zh: 加入夜间栖居者：唯一目标是捕食玩家与狼，头顶长着幻翼膜，击杀后可获得该材料。
categories: adventure; cursed; fabric; forge; game-mechanics; mobs

name: Animal Garden - Red Panda
summary: Adds tamable red pandas into the game with many different type of animations to make them and your world more lively.
intro_zh: 加入可驯服的小熊猫：驯服后生命从 8 提升到 25，用非竹子物品右键可切换漫游、坐下与跟随；进入跟随时会叫一声示意。生成于丛林与竹林，有默认与喜马拉雅两个变体，幼体偏灰。

name: In Your World
summary: You are a player who has created his world but something is wrong, someone else inhabits it before you.
intro_zh: 环境心理恐怖：玩家独自创造世界，却感觉有人先住进来，出现脚步声、天空异象、漂浮结构与被注视感；没有固定追逐，事件随机且可配置。

name: Player Mobs
summary: Adds hostile mobs that looks like players, works with remote list like Twitch subs
intro_zh: 加入外表像玩家的敌对生物：可在配置或远程名单（如 Twitch 订阅）中添加名字，同名玩家不会被打；会掉落对应皮肤的头颅，可用命令手动刷新名单与生成。

name: You've Goat to be Kidding Me
summary: Block breaking Ram Blocks, Thatch, Viking Helmet and Geeps!
intro_zh: 扩展 1.18 山羊：加入用羊角制作的撞角方块，可配合活塞破坏方块并击退实体；野蛮头盔在低血量时提供力量与速度；还有山羊肉，以及山羊与绵羊杂交的 Geep。

name: Undead Unleashed - Continued
summary: Adds new formidable fantasy-like enemies with unique abilities.
intro_zh: 黑暗中世纪风格亡灵扩展：例如恐惧骑士会举盾防御并猛烈劈砍；幽灵在受击后消失并从暗处伏击，暴露在阳光下会被灼烧。
categories: adventure; equipment; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Snow Pig [Forge]
summary: Ever wanted a pig in snowy biomes? No? Well here you go anyway!
intro_zh: 加入冻猪：与普通猪相似，掉落冻猪排，可解冻或用火焰附加解冻；生成于寒冷群系，被流浪者击杀会掉落专属音乐唱片。

name: Tiny Dragons
summary: Adopt, tame and explore with your own Tiny Dragons!
intro_zh: 可在神殿、堡垒、地牢等结构宝箱中找到龙蛋，放在营火、岩浆块或熔岩中约 10 分钟孵化，出生为随机品种的野生小龙，再驯服为伙伴。

name: The Five Nights at Freddy's | FNAF Mod
summary: Bring monsters from the FNAF Franchise straight into your minecraft world!
intro_zh: 把《玩具熊的五夜后宫》的角色、基于系列作品的建筑与可用的监控摄像头搬进游戏。
categories: adventure; decoration; food; forge; mobs; worldgen

name: Vanimals
summary: Vanimals adds vanilla friendly animals to your Minecraft world.
intro_zh: 加入可驯服、骑乘与狩猎的动物：野牛可骑乘冲锋、产奶、掉角做骨粉；还有拿破仑鱼等，配套大量新机制，目前为 Alpha。
categories: adventure; food; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; transportation; utility; worldgen

name: Aquatic Frontiers
summary: The Ultimate Aquatic MOD
intro_zh: 加入 5 种水生生物：海绵鱿鱼、Sandy、珊瑚傀儡、巨型鱿鱼与珊瑚蟹，各有专属掉落、生成条件与行为。

name: Valarian Conquest
summary: Valarian Conquest aims to enhance the overall feeling of combat and exploration in the overworld. It adds new factions, structures and mobs in an effort to make the world feel more alive, medieval and explorable.
intro_zh: 强化主世界战斗与探索：加入多个可加入、结盟的阵营，各有专属护甲与结构；可解救并收编阵营居民，让其从事村民职业或战斗角色并随你冒险。
categories: adventure; equipment; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: MCDoom
summary: Adds content from Doom to Minecraft.
intro_zh: 把《毁灭战士》搬进游戏：50 多种恶魔，从 Imp 到 Archvile，各有能力与弱点，并配备近十种新武器。
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; quilt; worldgen

name: Wandering Ribbit
summary: Addon mod of Ribbits that add the wandering ribbit
intro_zh: Ribbits 附属：加入流浪商人蛙，4.0 起生成于森林中的小帐篷结构。可交易 Ribbits 物品，蹲下持紫水晶右键可刷新交易，包括指向最近蛙村的地图与提供缓降的伞叶。

name: In The Corners (horror)
summary: In The Corners, a Minecraft mod that will terrify you. This mod adds 43 stalking, seeking and killing entities to your world.
intro_zh: 恐怖模组：加入 43 种跟踪、搜寻与猎杀实体，生成有延迟且可配置；作者明确不建议在服务器使用。

name: Super Block World (Forge)
summary: New content based on Super Mario, including mobs, items, blocks and a dimension.
intro_zh: 超级马里奥主题：加入方块、生物、物品与一个新维度。
evidence: mobs, items, blocks and a dimension
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; forge; mobs; worldgen

name: Pomkots Mechs
summary: Adds variety of mechs such as vehicles, mobs, bosses to your world!
intro_zh: 加入多种机甲、载具、生物与首领，可自定义机甲；目前非常 Alpha，附带召唤物品，不含掉落表与自动生成。

name: Animal Garden - Bull Shark
summary: This mod adds the aggressive underwater creature, the bull shark into the game.
intro_zh: 加入公牛鲨：生成于温暖海洋与河流，稀有但危险。它有隐形饥饿条，5 分钟饿满，可喂食、吃水中掉落的鱼肉或咬人来恢复；受伤会进入暴怒，并有三种行为模式。

name: Animal Garden - Meerkat
summary: Adds tamable meerkat into the game, that will fight and protect you.
intro_zh: 加入可驯服的狐獴：杂食，可用任意食物驯服与繁殖；未驯服时会躲避玩家与怪物，可用食物引诱，生成于稀树草原。

name: The Doppelganger 2
summary: "Things aren’t always as they appear."
intro_zh: 加入会窃取外貌并模仿行为的替身生物，以及伪装成牛、猪、鸡、狼、蜘蛛与蜜蜂的变体。

name: Aquatic Creepers
summary: New creepers that can appear in the oceans! Discover the new items and increase the difficulty of the ocean.
intro_zh: 加入水下苦力怕：生成于海洋与河流，生命只有普通苦力怕的一半，能在 15 格内发现玩家并游来，靠近几秒后爆炸；生成率低且可配置，并加入专属物品。
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; utility; worldgen

name: Feur Dungeon Spawner
summary: [Vanilla+] New cave structure, custom mob spawner and creatures.
intro_zh: 加入 15 个以上地下结构：废弃监狱、深层矿坑、废弃矿井、僵尸矿工巢穴、有幽灵守卫的紫水晶洞，以及有敌对机器人的红石实验室等。

name: Block Factory's Biomes
summary: 🌳 This Biomes Add-on adds 3 brand-new biomes filled with unique animals, plants, blocks, and fully custom world generation!
intro_zh: 加入 5 个 Vanilla+ 群系，各有独特动物、植物、方块与完整自定义地形生成，风格贴合原版。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; food; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Cosmic Horror
summary:
You're not just surviving — you're being watched.

Unseen entities linger just beyond your perception, whispering through the fog and shifting
intro_zh: 克苏鲁式心理恐怖：开局世界就已改变，包含 10 多种自然事件、稀有遭遇、会从不可能的位置观察你的生物、现实故障、时间扭曲、异常月相与少量 jumpscare。
categories: adventure; cursed; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: witherzilla
summary: some powerful boss and Weapon!
intro_zh: 加入超规格首领 Witherzilla：普通难度 1000 万生命，噩梦模式 2000 万，拥有秒杀级伤害、召唤恶魔头颅、原初闪电、定向爆破与代码攻击等机制。

name: Critters n' Crawlers
summary: A small mod that expands the temperate & cold biomes by adding north American animals & myths!
intro_zh: 为温带与寒带补充野生动物与传说生物：麋鹿、郊狼、 Timber Wolf、白尾鹿、美洲狮、狼獾、巨野猪、鹅、黑熊、河狸、鼠、蛇、响尾蛇、火鸡、驯鹿、臭鼬、土拨鼠、骡鹿，以及 Wendigo、Skinwalker、卓柏卡布拉等。

name: Slenderman: The Revival
summary: A Slenderman Horror Mod!
intro_zh: 加入“细长森林”群系与 Slenderman：破坏森林结构中的书页有概率获得“Slender Attraction”，随后在附近生成。它会跟踪、瞬移、爬柱，直视一段时间后攻击，离开群系 30 秒后消失。

name: Brazilian Expansion
summary: Adds Brazilian Fauna and Flora and other things.
intro_zh: 以巴西六大生物群系（亚马逊、大西洋森林、塞拉多、卡廷加、潘帕、潘塔纳尔）为灵感，加入巴西的动植物与民俗传说生物，如美洲豹、鳄鱼与鬃狼等。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; food; forge; mobs; worldgen

name: Red Panda
summary: Add the nice Red Panda.
intro_zh: 加入小熊猫：生成于丛林，爱吃竹子、鸡蛋与甜浆果；喂食后可以成为朋友，但不会跟随你，而是趴在你肩上。

name: Ribbits: Croaks
summary: An extension to the popular Ribbits mod, that adds rival frogs (Croaks), and more!
intro_zh: Ribbits 附属：加入敌对蛙 Croaks，需要保卫蛙村；制作 Ribbot 箱可召唤 Ribbot 协助防守。新增抛光与砖紫水晶、腐木等方块，可制作蛙之歌唱片与沼泽灾祸药水；喝下后靠近蛙村会触发 Croak 袭击。
categories: adventure; decoration; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge

name: Animal Garden - Manatee
summary: This mod adds the gentle giant the manatee(sea cow) into the game.
intro_zh: 加入海牛：在河流与海滩附近缓慢游动，受惊时会加速；可用海草与海带引诱。长时间待在水里背上会长出藻类，可用海绵或刷子清理，清理时还会掉落挂在背上的物品。

name: Who's There?: Ghost Players
summary: Adds entities with random names that spawn in caves and walk to spook the player
intro_zh: 在洞穴中随机出现隐形、名字像玩家的实体，会在你挖矿时走动并发出声响；另有名为“White Eyes”的变体，会在洞穴中跟踪玩家。

name: Siren Head: Java Edition
summary: Adds a modern legend to Minecraft!
intro_zh: 加入警笛头，展开一场都市传说风格的恐怖冒险。

name: Ecological Replenishment Station
summary: A mod that brings fantastical creatures based on scientific conjectures into your world!
intro_zh: 基于“六足祖先”这一科学假设，加入一整套新群系与生物：所有生物共享六肢蓝图，并在不同环境中特化出行走、奔跑、攀爬、挖掘等器官，部分还出现与主世界生物的趋同演化。

name: Splendid Slimes
summary: Data-driven slime ranching! Collect Plorts from slimes for various resources.
intro_zh: 史莱姆牧场式资源生产：喂食不同史莱姆，长大后产出 Plort，可拆解为资源或在培育器中做成史莱姆心；两种史莱姆混养可成 Largo，混入第三种会腐化成危险的 Tarr。默认包含 19 个品种。

name: Kenny [HORROR]
summary: Kenny watches from a distance before the warnings build into a hunt that only ends when the Ender Dragon is defeated.
intro_zh: 恐怖战役：从远处目击与异常事件开始，逐步升级为跨维度追猎；击杀 Kenny 只能拖延，击败末影龙才能彻底终结。它会近战、火球、TNT、跳跃追击、投掷玩家与生物，且进度跨死亡与重启保留。
categories: adventure; cursed; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge

name: Horror Cryptid: Sasquatch (Bigfoot)
summary: Adds Bigfoot to the game in a scary way
intro_zh: 加入大脚怪：只生成于原始松林，会随时间或玩家行为越来越愤怒；模组围绕夜间低能见度设计，并加入狩猎塔、废弃铁路等场景。

name: Animal Garden - Mouse
summary: Adds tamable mice into the game, that will fight and protect you.
intro_zh: 加入可驯服的老鼠：生成于森林、沙漠与恶地，有 8 种颜色，10% 概率生成更强更大的头目鼠；可用任意食物驯服繁殖，喂腐肉后攻击会附带 15 秒中毒。

name: Wyrmroost
summary: Re-imagining the world of Minecraft by filling it with diverse, tameable dragons that roam the new and beautiful worlds awaiting to be explored by those who dare to venture into such territories, where magic advances beyond enchanting. This, Is Wyrmroost.
intro_zh: 以龙为核心：加入多种可驯服的龙，可用于战斗、 farming 与交通等；驯服需要投入，计划扩展到 8 种龙。

name: Player2 AI NPC
summary: This is not just another companion mod; it is a live showcase of the PlayerEngine framework, built to fundamentally change our perception of AI NPCs in Minecraft.
intro_zh: AI 同伴：可在聊天中用自然语言下指令，例如要木头或清理僵尸，它会砍树、挖矿并战斗，基于 Player2 AI 与 PlayerEngine 框架。
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; social

name: Whaleborne
summary: Adds a new hullback mob and pirate ship mechanics
intro_zh: 加入深海生物 Hullback：用斧与剪刀清理它身上的附着物后会欠你人情，可上鞍并用 64 块木板或兼容材料装甲；在沉船与宝藏中找到帆、炮等部件后安装，用新舵物品操控。
categories: adventure; forge; mobs; neoforge; transportation; utility; worldgen

name: ITS NOT REAL [Legacy]
summary:
ITS NOT REAL 
another minecraft horror mod
intro_zh: 恐怖模组：加入“闭眼”功能（默认 G 键）与世界中的异常；建议配合实体修复模组，不适合多人游戏。

name: The Starved Stalker
summary: More than just another dweller.
intro_zh: 加入饥饿潜行者：会感知并走向玩家，靠近后开始追逐；“饥饿原野”会侵蚀世界，其中的生物同样危险；击败饥荒化身可获得丰厚奖励。

name: Waddles
summary: Waddles adds cute Adélie penguins that waddle
intro_zh: 加入阿德利企鹅：生成于雪原、冰刺与雪地类群系，带真实音效；计划补充游泳动画与水下 AI。

name: Create: Splendid Cogs
summary: A Splendid Slimes addon that adds a Create inspired slime
intro_zh: Splendid Slimes 附属：加入机械史莱姆，爱吃安山岩与其他石头、原矿，可帮你暂存物品；其 Plort 可转化为安山合金、黄铜或玫瑰石英。

name: Beneath
summary: A nether expansion for TerraFirmaCraft.
intro_zh: TFC 的下界扩展：加入矿脉、会塌方的方块、树木与农业等 TFC 式内容，危险与收益都更高。
categories: adventure; cursed; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Luminous: Beasts
summary: Illuminate your world with 26 new LEGENDARY beasts and their rare variants!
intro_zh: 从 Luminous 拆出的野兽篇：加入 8 只主世界传说野兽与 2 只下界传说野兽，各有血量与生成群系，击败后可获得奖杯、音乐唱片与战利品。

name: Brutal Nightmare : Insane Difficult
summary: Minecraft too easy? Try this mods with nearly 40 modifiers - settings new mini bosses, which made minecraft become hard & insane.  Enhanced hostile mobs' AI & Angry passive mob. Zombie place/break blocks. Skeleton,Spider,Creeper,Enderman.
intro_zh: 高难度模组：强化僵尸与骷髅 AI，并给末影人、溺尸、女巫等新能力；近 40 项修饰可开关，另有小型首领。
categories: adventure; bukkit; cursed; datapack; equipment; fabric; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; paper; purpur; quilt; spigot; utility; worldgen

name: Lost Souls
summary: The Lost Cities addon to add more danger to the buildings.
intro_zh: 失落之城附属：让建筑有概率“闹鬼”，生成强化过的原版生物，杀够指定数量才算清理；不受光照影响，生成种类、数量、装备与强度均可配置，仅服务端生效。

name: Myths of The Sea
summary: Discover new mythological aquatic creatures, such as the Leviathan, the Kraken, the Hippocampus, and many more!
intro_zh: 加入神话海洋生物：利维坦生成于寒冷海洋，极稀有，150 心生命，可秒杀无甲玩家，高速突袭后绕圈再攻击；还有沼泽常见的 Bunyip 等，各有独特行为与掉落。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; transportation; utility

name: Animal Garden - Fennec Fox
summary: This mod adds the Fennec Fox as a mob to your world.
intro_zh: 加入耳廓狐：沙漠生成，杂食，可用任意食物驯服；未驯服时受击会惊慌并躲避附近实体，会叼起地上的物品带走，食物类物品会在受伤时吃掉。

name: Animal Garden - Common Raven
summary: This mod adds the Common Raven as a mob to your world.
intro_zh: 加入渡鸦：会从地上偷物品并稍后丢下；连叫四声表示找到想拿的东西。驯服后会交给玩家并可坐下，否则会尽量丢在漏斗附近；可切换漫游、跟随等三种模式。
categories: fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; transportation; worldgen

name: Ore Creeper
summary: Add Creepers that when it explodes they transform the surroundings into Ores!
intro_zh: 加入矿物苦力怕：爆炸会把周围方块变成对应矿物，爆炸不造成伤害；可用矿石 TNT 把普通苦力怕转化，生成率与爆炸范围可配置。
evidence: Creepers that transform the surroundings into Ores
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge

name: FinzWild:Friends
summary: Add Little Serpents from Another World!
intro_zh: 加入可驯服的小蛇 Nillo：有普通、猎人（高攻）、池塘（水生）、滑翔（飞行）、岩石（高防）等类型，另有可骑乘的大型 Gillo，并配套护甲。

name: EnchantWithMob
summary: add Enchanter and Mob enchant From Minecraft Dungeons
intro_zh: 加入《我的世界：地下城》的附魔师：会给其他敌对生物附魔强化，死亡可能掉落生物附魔书，也会加入村庄袭击；高难度下敌人可能自带附魔，另有远古生物。

name: Stoneveil
summary: Grumblos is love, Grumblos is life
intro_zh: 加入生物 Grumblos 与石像鬼方块：Grumblos 在闪电击中石像鬼时出现，会成群吓唬生物、坐在它们身上并猎杀蠹虫，怕镐；可收成随身携带的小型 Grumblos。

name: Animal Garden - Sugar Glider
summary: This mod adds the tamable Sugar Glider as a mob into your world.
intro_zh: 加入蜜袋鼯：杂食，可用任意食物驯服繁殖；驯服后若附近有敌视主人的生物会尖叫预警，可切换三种行为；能爬墙并在空中滑翔。

name: Animal Garden - Western Gorilla
summary: This mod adds the Western Gorilla as a mob to your world.
intro_zh: 加入西部大猩猩：生成于丛林与竹林，可用食物建立“友谊”但不会跟随；领地意识强，未驯服的银背会互相争斗，并攻击被视为威胁的目标。

name: Bok's Banging Butterflies
summary: This mod adds butterflies with a full life cycle to the world of Minecraft. Butterflies can be caught or released using a butterfly net. Once caught, they can be bottled and placed in the world as decorative objects.
intro_zh: 加入有完整生命周期的蝴蝶与飞蛾：多种现实与幻想品种，寿命、速度与外观各异；可用捕虫网捕捉、装瓶摆放或钉在纸上收藏，蝴蝶会在树叶上产卵。

name: MonsterPlus
summary: New mobs of each and every flavor to improve the exploration experience: biome-exclusive monsters, new challenges and more!
intro_zh: 按环境加入专属敌人：沙漠女术士与侍僧（火系法术）、地下漂浮的幽灵骷髅、深处发光的发光骷髅等，掉落可用于制作特殊武器与装备。

name: Animal Garden - White Rhinoceros
summary: This mod adds the White Rhino to the game to bring more life to the savanna biomes.
intro_zh: 加入白犀牛：生成于草原，受击或附近有幼崽时立刻暴怒，先冲锋把目标撞飞；每次喂食只有 10% 概率驯服，驯服后不跟随，但会攻击伤害主人的敌人；雌雄体型与血量不同。

name: Zombie Nightmare Expansions - Undead Horror Monsters
summary: Adds various creepy undead entities with unique mechanics and intricate designs
intro_zh: 恐怖亡灵扩展：加入开膛者（巨型僵尸，寻找玩家与牛进食，掉腐化之心）与折磨史蒂夫（伪装成玩家，移动时现出真身，可能倒挂在天花板伏击）等，生成率可单独配置。

name: Dragon Mounts Datapack
summary: Dragon Mounts Datapack adds the Ability to Hatch Dragon Eggs into Rideable Pet Dragons!
intro_zh: 数据包：用龙蛋、末影之眼与回响碎片合成可孵化龙蛋，按放置群系孵出森林、水、冰、火等 5 种龙；约 3 个游戏日后孵化，喂鱼加速成长，最终可骑乘。
categories: adventure; datapack; fabric; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge; quilt; transportation; utility

name: Devourer of Gods
summary: This mod brings Devourer of Gods from Terraria Calamity to Minecraft!
intro_zh: 把《泰拉瑞亚》灾厄的噬神者搬进游戏：面向终局装备设计的高难度首领，带 3D 战斗与“吞噬末影龙”过场；所有掉落与行为变量均可配置。

name: ShineaL's Prehistoric Expansion
summary: Mythology And Prehistoric Creatures Reclaim The Overworld
intro_zh: 加入恐龙、史前生物、已灭绝动物与神话生物，每种都有独立动画、掉落与行为。

name: Guard Ribbits
summary: Add guard ribbits to the Ribbit villages
intro_zh: 为 Ribbits 加入守卫蛙，会不惜代价保护蛙村；模型与材质由 obatkuat 制作。

name: Goblin's Tyranny
summary: Discover a new village with a lot of randomly generated structure in it with some unique goblins, structures, items, mounts and pets !
intro_zh: 加入 RPG 风格哥布林：主世界有哥布林村庄与零散结构，多数对玩家敌对，可伪装成哥布林混入；也有酒保与用蘑菇交易的商人。流浪哥布林可用金币换包括“诱饵”在内的物品，扔出诱饵会让周围生物转而攻击它。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; food; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; transportation; worldgen

name: Prehistoric Fauna
summary: A mod about traveling to times long gone.
intro_zh: 时间旅行与史前主题：加入 3 个中生代维度，各按地质层设计群系，共 21 种灭绝动物，从早期恐龙与哺乳动物近亲到三角龙、霸王龙；另有 7 种树与 12 种植物。击败首领 Henos 获得时间宝石，与化石合成对应时代的图腾。
categories: adventure; decoration; equipment; food; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Mebahel's Creatures - Draugr Invasion
summary: A Skyrim-inspired Minecraft adventure mod featuring intelligent Draugr, massive Nordic dungeons filled with puzzles and hidden rooms, boss fights, magical traps, personal multiplayer loot, and a repeatable invasion that hunts the player.
intro_zh: 《上古卷轴》风格：加入智能 Draugr，会格挡、受伤后治疗、施法并团队作战；配套北欧大型地牢、谜题、隐藏房间、首领战、魔法陷阱，以及会追猎玩家的可重复入侵事件。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; forge; game-mechanics; magic; mobs; neoforge; quilt; worldgen

name: The Mandela Catalogue: Alternates
summary: The Alternates have invaded the world of Minecraft!
intro_zh: 加入《曼德拉记录》中的 Alternates：几乎免疫所有伤害，只能用火杀死。
categories: adventure; cursed; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Animal Garden - Spotted Hyena
summary: This mod adds the Spotted Hyena into the game.
intro_zh: 加入斑鬣狗：沙漠与草原生成，机会主义猎手；每次喂食只有 10% 概率驯服且不会跟随，受伤后会吃地上食物回血；远距离冲刺、近距离缓步接近，随后跃起撕咬。

name: War Wither
summary: This mod adds a powerful new boss—the "War Wither"—which is stronger and more agile than the standard Wither.
intro_zh: 加入比原版更强更灵活的战争凋灵首领：可配置为替代灵魂沙召唤的凋灵，也可用下界之星把普通凋灵转化；属性与伤害上限可调。

name: The Farlanders
summary: After the Far Lands vanished long ago, the inhabitants known as Farlanders, ancestors of the Enderman, were forced to start new lives.
intro_zh: 加入末影人先祖 Farlander：来自已消失的远境，适应主世界并建立家园，演化出末影人、末影幼体乃至泰坦；含多个结构、进度、新矿石与十多种生物。
categories: adventure; forge; game-mechanics; magic; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: BOB's Originium dream
summary: Adapted from Originium creature from Arknights, which adds varieties of Originium mobs in the Land.
intro_zh: 源自《明日方舟》：加入可繁殖的源石虫 Oriworm，用铁喂养训练成强力生物，也可食用；敌对的 Pompeii、Milan、Roamhouse 等需要战斗；源石矿若不加控制会生成强力源石生物首领。

name: Shut Your Eyes
summary: Do you wanna play a game?
intro_zh: 恐怖实体：会跟踪玩家并在最脆弱时攻击；听到提示音时闭眼（默认 G）可防被杀，需在音效提示他离开后再睁眼；还有屏息键（默认回车）与可配置的事件参数。
evidence: Do you wanna play a game

name: Distant Worlds
summary: Adds dimension with its own biomes, materials, mobs and even new crafting method
intro_zh: 科技魔法风格：加入一个含多种主题群系的新维度，可战斗与驯服生物、使用大量建筑与功能方块，并有新的合成方式；后续还会加入更多维度。
evidence: mobs and even new crafting method
categories: adventure; equipment; food; forge; magic; mobs; worldgen

name: Animal Garden -Alligator Gar
summary: This mod adds another Apex Predator, the Alligator Gar into the rivers of your world.
intro_zh: 加入鳄雀鳝：河流中的机会主义掠食者与食腐者，会偶尔咬附近生物。掉落可作箭矢材料的鳞片与骨粉、骨头；会吃水中的肉与鱼回血，离开视野会消失，用命名牌命名后保留。

name: Italian Brain Rot
summary: Add more than 12 creatures from the ITALIAN BRAIN ROT!
intro_zh: 把网络梗宇宙的生物加入游戏：输入 /start 召唤“脑腐商人”，用特定物品组合兑换各生物刷怪蛋，例如 Tung Tung Tung Sahur 需要 16 个橡木与 64 根木棍。

name: Legendary Creatures
summary: New challenging daylight creatures
intro_zh: 面向挑战的敌对生物：Shroomling 和平、稻草人在破坏作物时出现、猎犬会冲锋并咬住定身、沙漠与森林 Mojo、蝎子带毒且可能背着小蝎；另有稀有的 Wisp，主世界给 30 经验、下界 80、末地 240。

name: Hybrid Birds
summary: A mod that adds a variety of new birds to the world of Minecraft
intro_zh: 加入 6 种新鸟类及幼体：公鸡在 32 格内叫醒玩家可给“Rooster's Calling”增益，火鸡可喂小麦增肥以提高肉量，珍珠鸡像鸡但一次可孵 4 只幼鸟。
categories: fabric; food; forge; mobs; neoforge; quilt

name: Midnight Madness
summary: Demons, souls, horrors, death... Face the fear, mortal!
intro_zh: 加入恶魔、灵魂与恐怖生物，兼容 Nonexistent+、Born in Chaos、Alex's Mobs 与暮色森林，可让这些模组的生物掉落灵魂。
categories: adventure; cursed; equipment; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; worldgen

name: Special Mobs
summary: Discover special mobs with distinct abilities in different dimensions!
intro_zh: 数据包：按维度加入特殊生物。主世界有史莱姆蜘蛛、野蛮人、忍者、矿工、强盗、冰射手与水鬼；下界有灵魂骑士、黑骑士、狂战士、堡垒守卫、绯红原住民、凋灵幽灵、S1enderman 与火灵；末地有紫颂幽灵。
categories: adventure; datapack; fabric; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge; quilt

name: SCP: Lockdown
summary: SCP: Lockdown adds a bunch of 'SCP's Derived from the SCP Wiki.
intro_zh: 按 SCP wiki 的原始设定加入 SCP 实体；1.20.1 版本目前为 Alpha。

name: Jurassic Saga
summary: Jurassic Saga is the Dinosaur Mod for you! It focuses on immersion of the Jurassic Park dinosaurs, ranging from novels, movies, comics, and toylines! With all of this, you can create your own Jurassic Park!
intro_zh: 侏罗纪公园题材：寻找化石与琥珀、提取并测序 DNA、复活恐龙与植物、构建人工生态，支持基因改造与混种，如暴虐霸王龙与暴虐迅猛龙；恐龙会因压力与环境产生行为变化。
categories: fabric; food; forge; game-mechanics; management; mobs; neoforge; storage; technology; transportation; worldgen

name: Slenderman
summary: A mod that adds Slenderman.
intro_zh: 加入瘦长鬼影与“细长森林”，可在其中找到他的书页；右键阅读会获得物品奖励，但代价未知。

name: Unusual Prehistory 2
summary: Uncover fossils and revive prehistoric creatures!
intro_zh: 全面重制：在地表各群系寻找化石，用刷子清理基质方块并敲开化石层，再到森林中的废弃实验室使用转化器，配合有机黏液复活史前动植物。

name: Foolish
summary: A large, exploration-themed mod adding biomes, mobs, weapons, and a new dimension: the Stellar Hollow.
intro_zh: 大型探索模组：加入 100 多种全动画生物、群系、趣味武器与新维度“星穹空洞”；同时扩展主世界、下界与末地群系，并加入地牢式结构。

name: Bossominium
summary: A mod that adds multiple new bosses that bring a challenge
intro_zh: 加入 23 个首领与 46 个成就，每个首领掉落独特材料，可制作进攻或防御向装备；开局赠送 Bossdexium 指导召唤，需要 GeckoLib。已停止更新。

name: Terra Entity
summary: A mod contains many monsters and bosses in Terraria
intro_zh: 《泰拉瑞亚》内容移植：加入 14 种史莱姆、14 种恶魔眼、多种哥布林、骷髅与虫类，以及 NPC、召唤物、悠悠球、回旋镖、鞭子、召唤法杖与首领。
categories: adventure; equipment; forge; library; mobs; neoforge

name: Demogorgon Mod
summary: Adds a strange creature, and more to your Minecraft experience!
intro_zh: 加入《怪奇物语》的魔神：生成于枯萎森林，怕火，着火后会受到更多伤害并畏惧玩家；有魔神殿结构、刷怪器，以及电池、手电与红石灯等科技。
categories: adventure; cursed; equipment; forge; mobs; technology; worldgen

name: Animal Garden - Prairie Dog
summary: This mod adds prairie dogs as tamable animals to your world.
intro_zh: 加入可驯服的草原犬鼠：生成于平原与草甸，杂食，可用任意食物驯服；驯服后附近有敌视主人的生物会吠叫预警，每 5 到 10 分钟有概率在地面挖出随机物品。

name: Ultimate Bosses
summary: Bosses to make sure you have more to do after you slay the Ender Dragon
intro_zh: 数据包：在末影龙之后追加失落天使、眼睛、风暴、术士等首领，以及僵尸骑手、飞行女巫、蓝色潜影贝、巨型幻翼、叠加烈焰人、烟花掠夺者、唤魔者之王、末影人之王与波塞冬等迷你首领。
categories: adventure; datapack; fabric; forge; magic; mobs; quilt

name: Burrowers
summary: Try to find these misterious lurking creatures and their villages underground!
intro_zh: 加入地下村民的远亲“Burrower”：像鼹鼠人一样在黑暗中生活、囤积资源并建造家园，看似友好但有所隐瞒；配套坚韧根与根木、洞穴蕨、地衣灯等方块。

name: Mushrooms Realm
summary: Два новых грибных торговца со своими торгами // Two new mushroom traders with their own markets
intro_zh: 加入红、褐两种蘑菇商人：每 5 到 60 分钟在玩家附近生成并停留 10 分钟。褐色在主世界用绿宝石把钻石装备换成带随机满级附魔的版本，红色在下界用同样方式处理下界合金装备。

name: The Hollow Stalker (horror)(not a dweller)
summary: The Hollow Stalker is a shadowy entity that stalks players silently in the darkness, attacking when they least expect it.
intro_zh: 恐怖实体：会缓慢爬近，靠近时发出脆响后开始极速追击，具有真实的攀爬与爬行行为，几乎无法甩开。

name: Aftershock
summary: Based on the Tremor series, this mod adds the Precambrian monsters of the deep into your Minecraft experience!
intro_zh: 加入地下的 Graboid：完整还原《异形魔怪》式生命周期，在泥土与沙子中潜行捕猎。
categories: fabric; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; quilt; worldgen

name: A Zombie Dinosaur
summary: This mod adds a Zombie Dinosaur to Minecraft!
intro_zh: 加入僵尸恐龙首领 Zombifaurus：400 生命，会尖叫释放毒气、踏地造成范围伤害与毒冲击波、甩颈眩晕、砸地产生地震波、甩尾造成范围攻击。
categories: adventure; equipment; forge; magic; mobs; worldgen

name: Mutationcraft
summary: Adds new terrifying parasite mutant creatures into the game!
intro_zh: 变异爆发：世界有爆发计时器，时间越久出现的变异体越强；从同化村民、灾厄村民、女巫与动物，逐步升级到更高层级的变异体，下界还有同化猪灵。
categories: adventure; cursed; equipment; forge; mobs; neoforge

name: Zombified Player - Kill Your Inner Zombie
summary: This Mod spawns a zombified version of the player after death.
intro_zh: 玩家死亡后生成使用其皮肤（带僵尸化覆盖层）的僵尸玩家，不惧阳光也不会消失；可配置把死亡物品转移到它身上，玩家需要击败“自己”才能取回。
evidence: spawns a zombified version of the player
categories: adventure; cursed; fabric; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge

name: Animal Garden - Harp Seal
summary: This mod adds the harp seal as tamable mob to the frozen ocean biome!
intro_zh: 加入可驯服的琴海豹：生成于冰冻海洋，需用鱼驯服，繁殖必须在水中；性格害羞会躲避玩家与北极熊，但会反击。休息与进食可回血，幼体为白色，成体有纹理变体，每 15 到 30 分钟蜕皮掉皮革。

name: Animal Garden - Hippopotamus
summary: This mod adds hippos as tamable animals to your world.
intro_zh: 加入河马：仅生成于草原，易被激怒，附近生物久留会引发暴走；可用小麦、草、苹果、西瓜片等驯服繁殖，每次仅 10% 概率；即使驯服也可能偶尔攻击，喂食可安抚。

name: Clay Soldiers
summary: Adds Clay Soldiers that fight for you!
intro_zh: 加入黏土士兵：用黏土与灵魂沙制作，放到地上后自动作战；可用木棍、燧石、萤石、皮革与羊毛升级攻击、发光与护甲，可染色、骑乘并配上马匹。

name: Animal Garden - Crocodile
summary: This mod adds crocodiles to your world to make the swamp a bit more dangerous place.
intro_zh: 加入鳄鱼：生成于沼泽，生物靠近一段时间后会张嘴示警并可能攻击；可用肉与鱼繁殖，有 9 种颜色变体，会随机选择上岸或下水，受伤时会吃地上食物回血。

name: Animal Garden - Lion
summary: This mod adds lions as tamable animals to your world.
intro_zh: 加入可驯服的狮子：生成于草原，每次喂食仅 10% 概率驯服；未驯服时会攻击周围生物（雌狮除外），咆哮会让附近非狮生物逃跑；雄狮有 15 种体色，雌狮 5 种。

name: Bountiful Critters
summary: Makes your world more bountiful with silly critters!
intro_zh: 加入翻车鱼（寒冷与普通海洋各一变体，可装桶，熟肉有概率给水下呼吸）、黄貂鱼（不同海域变体，靠近会被刺）与鸸鹋（产蛋可煮）等动物。

name: Alex's Caves Continued
summary: Alex's Caves Continued aims to port and update the original mod to keep it alive and working for newer versions.
intro_zh: Alex's Caves 的移植续作：保留 6 个手工洞穴群系、43 种生物与 350 多个方块，内容未改动，覆盖 1.20.1 至 26.2 的 Forge、Fabric 与 NeoForge 共 58 个构建。
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Jurassic Revived
summary: A Minecraft mod that brings dinosaurs back to life using ancient DNA and modern technology | Experience the classic old models with improved performance, and build your own prehistoric park with a wide variety of creatures...
intro_zh: 免费恐龙模组：挖化石、提取 DNA，用高科技机器复活恐龙；恐龙有物种专属 AI，会攻击、逃跑、漫游与群居，并提供围栏、实验室、研究区与观景台等园区建造工具。
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; game-mechanics; management; mobs; neoforge; technology; transportation

name: Tameable Beasts
summary: A mod that brings back the taming mechanic
intro_zh: 恢复并扩展驯服机制，加入可驯服的野兽，让玩家能像原版驯狼一样与更多生物建立伙伴关系。
categories: equipment; food; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge

name: Abyssbound
summary: a mod that adds new biomes, mobs, bosses and structures based of the void
intro_zh: 加入“深渊之域”维度与多个对比强烈的群系：虚空怪物、不只用于攻防的装备、雾中失落的背景设定，以及多阶段首领 Gravorax。
categories: adventure; equipment; forge; magic; mobs; worldgen

name: Snekcraft
summary: A mod that adds pet snakes
intro_zh: 加入球蟒、玉米蛇与西部猪鼻蛇，多种颜色与花纹变体只能通过繁殖获得；可用生鸡肉或兔肉繁殖，卵在沙或泥土上孵化，并带遗传机制。

name: Dark Mist Dweller
summary: Adds cloudy entity that hunts you when it's getting night
intro_zh: 加入雾中生物：等玩家靠近后现身并开始追猎；普通武器杀不死，跳进河里或尝试烧掉它才可能脱身，村庄里的铁傀儡能对付它。

name: Fintastic
summary: yet another mod that adds fish and aquarium keeping related items and blocks
intro_zh: 水族饲养与鱼类繁殖：加入 featherback、米诺鱼、鲶鱼、淡水鲨、孔雀鱼、巨骨舌鱼、清道夫、月鱼、腔棘鱼、斗鱼、水蚤与丰年虾等，装桶可查看俗名与学名，并带鱼类遗传玩法。
categories: adventure; decoration; food; forge; mobs; neoforge; utility; worldgen

name: Deer Mod
summary: This mod adds deers to the game!
intro_zh: 加入鹿：可用鹿饼与它们互动，另有鹿纹旗帜与盾牌图案等内容。

name: Choup's Drakvyrn Mod
summary: Dragon with a different name, armors, fights... for the new versions of Minecraft !
intro_zh: 加入较小的龙类 Drakvyrn：在稀有“龙之手”遗迹找到远古蛋，右键孵化后需与其战斗才能获得可驯服的蛋；把蛋带到下界可孵出下界变体。
categories: adventure; equipment; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Bacterium
summary: Bacterium Mod For Minecraft
intro_zh: 基因工程细菌：可吃掉世界中部分或全部方块，例如清空沙漠的沙子或把沙地变成草地，力量强大需要谨慎使用。
categories: adventure; fabric; forge; magic; mobs; neoforge

name: Bats Galore
summary: Adds many bats with unique loot for spooky season.
intro_zh: 加入大量蝙蝠变体：多数在主世界与下界自然生成，击杀掉落专属糖果，但不一定都有益；另有虚空蝙蝠，点击会把你传送到末地，并加入“动乱祭坛”结构与四种核心。

name: The Ducks
summary: Add ducks to the game.
intro_zh: 加入鸭子：沼泽生成绿头鸭、针叶林生成北京鸭，可用海草繁殖，像鸡一样下可染色的蛋；掉落鸭肉，命名为 Donald 会变成唐老鸭皮肤，另有多种彩蛋皮肤。

name: Chiikawa
summary: The Chiikawa Mod brings the world of Chiikawa into Minecraft: the characters of Chiikawa come to live in your world, so you can experience the world of Chiikawa in Minecraft.
intro_zh: 把《吉伊卡哇》的角色加入游戏：世界中可以遇到这些角色，部分可用食物驯服成为宠物。

name: Imposter (horror)
summary: You will never guess it's your friend or hostile entity that's mimicing your friend!
intro_zh: 恐怖模组：加入伪装成朋友的敌对实体；默认会破坏方块并录制语音，可在配置中关闭。

name: Desert Behemoths: Sandworms!
summary: Adds massive Dune-like sandworms to make deserts a bit more exciting.
intro_zh: 加入《沙丘》沙虫：在沙漠奔跑或规律跳跃会吸引它，被追上只能离开沙漠；可用活塞与红石中继器制作“捣蛋器”主动召唤。

name: Wings Of Fire!
summary: Ever Wanted to ride a Phoenix? Now you can! Find 6 different phoenix eggs around your world and treat them to hatch your new mount!
intro_zh: 加入 6 种凤凰：在结构中找到石化凤凰蛋，用“炼狱摇篮”加热 15 分钟，再与“回火灯笼”绑定，右键即可召唤并骑乘。
categories: adventure; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; transportation

name: Biodiverse
summary: All the mobs to liven up the environments of minecraft, including whales, musk ox, cheetahs, and much more
intro_zh: 加入 26 种动物：深海鮟鱇敌对并掉落发光器与鱼肉，白鲸会跟随玩家并帮忙驱赶敌对生物，黑熊有六种毛色，另有鲸、麝牛、猎豹等，各有行为与用途。

name: SoniCraft Demons
summary: A spooky creepypasta add-on for SoniCraft (Warning: contains gore, jumpscares, and disturbing imagery)
intro_zh: SoniCraft 附属：加入新方块、物品、护甲与工具类型、首领与 4 个可探索维度，收录 Sonic.EXE、Xenophanes 等恐怖都市传说角色。
categories: adventure; cursed; decoration; equipment; forge; magic; mobs

name: Animal Garden - Narwhal
summary: This mod adds the unicorns of the sea, the narwhals to the frozen ocean biomes.
intro_zh: 加入独角鲸：生成于冰冻海洋，需用鱼驯服与繁殖；在水中每 30 秒回血，可靠吃水中鱼或手喂恢复；有漫游、休息、跟随三种行为，能长不同大小的角，受击有 1% 概率掉牙。

name: Animal Garden - Springhare
summary: This mod adds another useful tamable critter to the savanna biomes, the Springhare!
intro_zh: 加入可驯服的跳兔：生成于草原，食草，可用植物类食物驯服；会吃草类方块加速成长与回血，跳得很高且夜行；每 5 到 10 分钟挖出物品，驯服后能嗅出附近甚至地下的目标方块并尖叫提醒。

name: Zelda: Hyrule Terrors
summary: Zelda-inspired Armor, Weapons, Mobs, and iconic gear from BOTW and TOTK!
intro_zh: 塞尔达主题：加入波克布林（成群出现，队长可召唤同伴，戴其头可避免被攻击）、利扎福斯（敏捷、带毒、可能持矛）、丘丘（可被火点燃）等 4 种生物，以及 BOTW/TOTK 的武器与护甲。
categories: adventure; equipment; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge

name: Symbiote: A Bonding Experience
summary: Symbiotes in Minecraft. Learn to get along with them, for your own sake.
intro_zh: 加入寄生共生体：在陨石中休眠，玩家靠近后与其绑定。它会保护你但也有欲望，拒绝会积累压力；共有捕食者、守护者、暗影、幽匿与王室 5 种菌株。

name: Mutant Iceologer Mod
summary: Woah this is one Buff Illager, Meet the Mutant Iceologer. This guy is a BEAST when it comes to fighting so be careful or you might be in for not a N-Ice time!
intro_zh: 加入变异冰术师：雪原夜间生成，会投掷巨大冰块并踏地，攻击村民、铁傀儡、玩家与雪傀儡；击杀掉落绿宝石、蓝冰、雪块与新冰方块。

name: Simple Enemy
summary: An Addon that works with TaCZ and adds NPCs to the game equipped with weapons from the latter mod, with the goal of balancing the presence of weapons in the game. Now you will have a reason to carry a weapon.
intro_zh: TaCZ 附属：加入持枪 NPC 与三个阵营（俄军、美军与可招募盟军），可用招募台或刷怪蛋招募，Ctrl+C 打开指挥菜单，Shift+右键查看背包。
evidence: NPCs to the game equipped with weapons

name: Antarchy
summary: Adding 45+ mobs, 8+ bosses, 3 fleshed out dimensions, and more
intro_zh: 加入 3 个完整维度、无限随机维度、45 种以上生物、8 个首领、强力武器与地牢；另有铀、钛等稀有矿石，以及终极与皇家装备线。
categories: adventure; cursed; equipment; fabric; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: A Very Unpleasant Mod
summary: This Unpleasant Gradient Shows Up In Your Minecraft World
intro_zh: 加入“不快渐变”矩形实体：在地表游荡、会开门但不关门，可用发酵蛛眼繁殖，纯属视觉上的“不快”。

name: Whisperer's Jungle Temple
summary: Adds a new temple structure to the game, along with two new mobs
intro_zh: 加入丛林神庙结构，以及两种新生物：低语者与丛林蜘蛛，另有新叶剑。
categories: adventure; equipment; forge; mobs; neoforge; worldgen

name: Annihilation Recreated
summary: datapack that aim to recreate the boss Annihilation from the Wynncraft server
intro_zh: 数据包：复刻 Wynncraft 的首领 Annihilation，重做了模型、材质与招式，音乐与结构直接取自原服务器。
categories: datapack; fabric; forge; mobs; neoforge; quilt

name: Wildlife Expanded: Skunk
summary: This mod adds tamable skunks to the game.
intro_zh: 加入可驯服的臭鼬：可用甜浆果驯服、胡萝卜繁殖，受击会喷向攻击者；可放在肩上，会吓退怪物，下界变体喷火，下界蘑菇变体喷毒。

name: Antlers of Hunger
summary: A high quality Wendigo horror mod inspired by the movie Antlers.
intro_zh: 恐怖追踪模组：把电影《Antlers》中的温迪戈加入游戏，提供 VIBRANT 与 MOVIE 两套外观，强调战斗与氛围。
categories: adventure; cursed; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; utility

name: Dweller dweller
summary: Tries to implement cave dweller in a vanilla-friendly way!!
intro_zh: 加入强力恐怖的 dweller dweller：击杀可得牙齿，可在村庄出售，3 颗牙可做项链，佩戴后能吓退附近的同类。

name: The Digimod
summary: A mod about rasing, evolving, training and battling with Digimon.
intro_zh: 数码宝贝题材：可养成、进化、训练与对战。
categories: adventure; equipment; food; forge; game-mechanics; mobs; neoforge

name: Muffin's Slime Golem
summary: Add Slime Golem to Minecraft. A good ally for finding Slime Chunks!
intro_zh: 加入史莱姆傀儡：在史莱姆块上放雕刻南瓜生成，会攻击敌对生物（史莱姆除外），进入史莱姆区块会在地面产出史莱姆藻；可用剪刀取南瓜，用蜂巢封住产出。

name: Arachnids
summary: Arachnids is a mod based on the first Starship Troopers movie and 2005 game about an alien race of bugs.
intro_zh: 《星河战队》题材：把电影与 2005 游戏中的外星虫族加入游戏，虫群控制主世界的沙漠。
